name: Correspondence 1: Immediate Spatial Perceptions / Landscape of the Mind
summary: Feel the space around you beyond your normal senses: judge exact distances, always know where north is, notice hidden things or people close by, and pick up warps, gates and other spatial oddities, including ones made by Correspondence magick.

name: Correspondence 2: Sense, Touch, Thicken and Reach Through Space / Correspondence Sensing
summary: Send your senses to another place and watch or listen there. You can also make the space around you dense, so it is harder for others to spy on you or to notice your own remote senses.
system: Remote senses leave small ripples that Correspondence 1 can pick up. Each success put into thickening space takes one success off a rival's attempt to spy on you or spot your senses. When Correspondence links another Sphere to a distant target, the Effect can go no higher than your Correspondence rank.

name: Correspondence 3: Pierce Space / Open or Close Gates / Co-locality Perceptions
summary: Open a small, brief hole in space and step through it to somewhere else, as long as you go alone and travel light. You can also watch several places at once, seen layered over each other like ghosts.
system: A close, familiar destination needs fewer successes than a far or unknown one, so look before you jump. Moving big things or heavy loads takes Correspondence 4.

name: Correspondence 4: Rend Space / Ward / Co-locate Self
summary: Open big, lasting gates between places and teleport while carrying heavy loads. Combined with a Pattern Sphere or Mind, you can seal things into a tiny realm of their own or ward a place so certain things cannot get in or out.
system: A permanent gate takes 10 or more successes. Wards and pocket realms need the Sphere of whatever they hold or keep out; Resonance wards need Prime 4. How Do You DO That? has the full ward rules.

optional.purpose: isolate or ward against energies
isolate or ward against living things
isolate or ward against objects
isolate or ward against minds
ward against a kind of Resonance

name: Correspondence 5: Spatial Mutation / Co-Location
summary: Treat distance and size as clay: stretch, shrink or resize things, tie separate Patterns together across space, or put two places or objects in the same spot.
system: Stacking places or objects on top of each other is extremely vulgar.

optional.purpose: resize or reshape objects
resize or reshape bodies
resize or reshape energies

name: Entropy 1: Sense Flaws, Fate and Fortune / Ring of Truth
summary: See the flow of chance. You can predict dice, cards and other random results, find the weak spot in an object, a person or an argument, and catch the tells that show whether someone believes what they say.

name: Entropy 2: Control Probability
summary: Steer random events: decide how dice or cards land, hit the same weak spot again and again, and nudge people and things toward the outcome you want.
system: Small shifts (who wins a race) take fewer successes than big ones (a six-car pileup). Entropy does no direct damage below rank 4.

name: Entropy 3: Affect Predictable Patterns
summary: Make objects break down faster or hold together longer, and start handing out good or bad luck to things and people.
system: Complex machines (cars, computers) are easier to make fail than simple solid things (walls, rocks). Bigger luck takes more successes.

name: Entropy 4: Affect Living Things
summary: Bless or curse living beings: give them remarkable vitality or a sudden illness, and lasting luck or misfortune.
system: From this rank Entropy deals and heals aggravated damage. How long-term luck shows up is up to the Storyteller.

name: Entropy 5: Affect Thought / Shape Memes / Binding Oath
summary: Bring order or decay to ideas: jumble a target's perceptions, build airtight arguments or tear beliefs and memories apart, start or kill memes, and tie someone's luck to an oath they swear.
system: A word or a glance is enough. A whim takes 1-2 successes, a fancy 3, setting or breaking a conviction 4-5, an obsession 5 or more. Usually coincidental; the difficulty is the subject's Willpower (at least 4). Scrambled synapses give dice penalties, and a broken oath brings very bad luck.

name: Forces 1: Perceive Forces
summary: Sense the energies around you: see in the dark, in infrared, ultraviolet or X-ray, follow sound and radio waves, notice electrical flow and motion, and hear beyond human range.

name: Forces 2: Manipulate Forces / Elemental Touch
summary: Push existing energy around, without making new energy: mute or boost sound, gather or banish shadows, bend light to hide things or change their color, cut electrical current, flare a flame, or redirect wind, momentum or gravity.
system: Covers about one human-sized target or a small area of roughly 20 feet; bigger areas need a higher rank. Forces attacks get one extra success of damage.

name: Forces 3: Transmute Minor Forces / Telekinetics / The Dragon's Touch
summary: Change one kind of energy into another and, with Prime, make it from nothing: fire, wind, electricity, gravity wells. Your reach grows to a few dozen yards or a handful of people.

optional.purpose: conjure new energy from nothing
wear energy down or build it up
turn thoughts into energy
turn spirit-stuff into physical energy
set an energy surge to go off later

name: Forces 4: Control Major Forces / Gift of Zeus / Weather-Witching
summary: Use the lower-rank tricks over a mile or more: change the weather, darken an area, raise or drop the temperature, and shield a place or wreck it.
system: Big Effects at this scale need many successes and are usually vulgar.

name: Forces 5: Transmute Major Forces / Conjuring Infernos
summary: Command energy across huge areas: raise a tornado under a clear sky, still the tides, set the air itself on fire.
system: Easier when conditions already lean that way (a cold snap in winter). Workings this big upset the weather afterwards and leave strong Resonance behind.

name: Life 1: Sense Life
summary: Read the living things around you: who is there, how old they are, their sex and how healthy they are.

optional.purpose: sense organisms far away
gauge their risk of illness or bad luck
see their past or future states
read the Quintessence flowing through them

name: Life 2: Alter Simple Life-Forms / Heal Self
summary: Reshape, heal or kill simple organisms such as plants, insects, shellfish and germs: make flowers bloom or wilt, trees bear fruit, give a crab wings. On yourself you can heal and make small changes to hair, skin, height or weight.
system: Life damage and healing is aggravated, because it works on the living Pattern itself.

name: Life 3: Transform Simple Life-Forms / Alter Self / Heal Others
summary: Radically change simple organisms or turn one kind into another (fruit into insects), and with Prime create them from raw energy. Give yourself gills, claws or armor while staying basically human. Heal, harm or put to sleep other complex creatures.
system: A creature changed beyond its own Pattern suffers Pattern bleeding: one level of lethal damage a day, until the change is fed with Prime or made permanent.

optional.purpose: create simple life from raw energy

name: Life 4: Alter Complex Life-Forms / Transform Self
summary: Make big changes to complex creatures like people, dogs and horses (extra limbs, thumbs, a bigger brain) without changing what they are. Turn yourself into another creature of about your own size and mass.
system: A new form's special abilities (flight, breathing water) only work if you build them in with extra Life magick, and the new body can take time to get used to.

name: Life 5: Transform and Create Complex Life-Forms / Perfect Metamorphosis
summary: Take any shape you like and reshape other complex creatures just as freely, make changes permanent, and build complex creatures from energy. Without other Spheres your creations are alive but have no mind or soul.

optional.purpose: create complex life from energy
give a creation a mind
turn a creature into energy or an element
turn a creature into matter
turn a creature into raw Quintessence
radically age or de-age a creature
radically age or de-age a creature
put a spirit into a creature
put a soul into a creature

name: Matter 1: Matter Perceptions
summary: Perceive what things are made of: their composition, internal structure, hidden layers and how stable they are.

optional.purpose: find an object's weak points
detect implants and other blends of tissue and material

name: Matter 2: Basic Transmutation
summary: Turn one substance into another as long as its shape, temperature and state (solid, liquid, gas) stay the same: lead into gold, wood into stone, water into wine.
system: Rare or complex materials need more successes than common ones. Works on simple, uniform substances; mixtures usually need Matter 3, though simple ones like bread or gunpowder can work with lots of successes. Radioactive materials fall under Forces.

optional.purpose: conjure material from energy or dissolve it into Quintessence
move an object through space
move an object through time
wake the sleeping spirit in an object

name: Matter 3: Alter Form
summary: Reshape materials however you like and temporarily change their state (steel into fog, water into glass). Change density, fuse broken pieces, or rip solid things apart.
system: Permanent state changes need Matter 5. With other Spheres you can join matter to living tissue, crumble it to dust or move it by thought.

name: Matter 4: Complex Transmutation
summary: Pull off complex and radical transformations, mostly with help from other Spheres: blend materials into cybernetics or electrified gold, or conjure a working gun, car or computer out of nothing if you know how it works.
system: Conjuring a complex device needs the right Abilities, an extended ritual and many successes.

name: Matter 5: Alter Properties
summary: Create materials that break the rules of science or do not exist on Earth, including radioactive ones.

optional.purpose: shape things like armor out of thin air
melt steel with a thought

name: Mind 1: Sense Thoughts and Emotions / Mind Shield / Empower Self
summary: Sense other people's moods and surface urges, scan auras, tell truth from lies. Shield your own mind, and sharpen it to follow several things at once, work faster, or raise a Mental Attribute for a scene or two.
system: Each success on a coincidental shield roll removes one success from anyone trying to read you. Each Empower Self success adds one dot to a Mental Trait. Reading a person's general state of mind takes a successful Arete roll.

optional.purpose: pick up psychic impressions from a place or object

name: Mind 2: Read Surface Thoughts / Empathic Bond / Create Impressions / Mental Impulse
summary: Skim what is on the surface of an unshielded mind, read emotions and the memories left on objects or places, and send a single word or feeling to someone else.
system: Simple feelings like a flash of anger are easy to send or read; layered emotions need more successes. Against unwilling minds the difficulty is usually the target's Willpower (at least 4), and they can resist with a Willpower roll.

name: Mind 3: Mental Link / Project Illusions / Dreamwalk / Psychic Blast
summary: Link minds for telepathy, read or sway someone's thoughts, put illusions in their head, walk into dreams and dream Realms, and hit a rival with a psychic attack.
system: Mind attacks do bashing damage: painful, rarely deadly. Adding Correspondence, Forces, Matter or Life gives telekinesis, pyrokinesis and similar powers, which are not coincidental.

name: Mind 4: Control Conscious Mind / Alter Consciousness / Astral Projection
summary: Take over someone's actions and thoughts, change their memories, drive them mad or bring them back, mask their aura, plant post-hypnotic commands, and leave your own body in astral form.
system: Social conditioning rules are on M20 pp. 605-607; astral travel on pp. 476-478.

name: Mind 5: Control Subconscious / Forge Psyche / Untether Consciousness
summary: Change a mind for good: raise or lower Traits, rewrite a personality or Nature, on others or on yourself. Roam the deep astral reaches for hours or days, or create a mind where none existed.

name: Prime 1: Etheric Senses / Consecration / Infuse Personal Quintessence
summary: See Quintessence moving through Nodes, Tass, Wonders and spells, try to read Resonance, and take in more Quintessence than your Avatar rating. Consecrate an object with your energy so it changes along with you when you shapeshift or step sideways.
system: Without Prime 1 a mage cannot hold more Quintessence than their Avatar rating. A consecrated item also carries your Resonance, which can be used to identify and reach you.

name: Prime 2: Fuel Pattern / Construct Patterns / Enchant Patterns / Body of Light
summary: Steer Quintessence into Patterns: with other Spheres, conjure new energy, life or matter out of thin air, and charge weapons, attacks or objects so they hurt spirits and deal aggravated damage, or guard against it. You can also project a glowing, insubstantial image of yourself.

name: Prime 3: Channel Quintessence / Enchant Life / Energy Weapon / Craft Periapts and Temporary Wonders
summary: Draw free or raw Quintessence from Nodes, Junctures and Tass and pour it into Patterns, fill a Periapt, make temporary Talismans and Devices, or form a weapon of pure energy.
system: Energy weapons deal aggravated damage and cost 1 Quintessence per use, or per turn if they last; they vanish when you run dry and are vulgar unless fired through tech or seen as a miracle. Permanent enchantment needs Prime 4.

name: Prime 4: Expel or Infuse Energy / Tap Wellspring / Craft Tass and Permanent Wonders
summary: Drain the Quintessence out of objects or energies (not yet living beings) to burn, crumble or wither them, or pack it in so an object cannot be broken. Fuse living and lifeless material into cybernetics and nanotech, enchant things permanently, and draw energy from exciting events.

name: Prime 5: Infuse or Withdraw Life Force / Create Node and Soulflower / Nullify Paradox
summary: Draw Quintessence from anything, anywhere: drain a living being until nothing is left, or fill one with so much life force they are blessed. Create Nodes in meaningful places and cancel out Paradox.
system: Draining a living being to nothing is vulgar. Nullifying Paradox is on M20 p. 549.

name: Spirit 1: Spirit Sight / Spirit Sense
summary: Sense spirits of every kind, gauge how thick the local Gauntlet is, read auras, peer into the Penumbra, and tell whether an object has a spirit side, as Fetishes do.
system: You are most in tune with spirits whose Resonance resembles yours. With other Spheres you can spot Awakened objects, elementals, possessed beings, Shallowings and Nodes.

name: Spirit 2: Touch Spirit / Manipulate Gauntlet
summary: Reach or call across the Gauntlet for a moment, talk to spirits and touch them briefly, and make the local Gauntlet thinner or thicker.
system: Each success moves the Gauntlet rating by one. In the material world a mage cannot push it below 4. Spirit Effects usually use the Gauntlet rating as difficulty.

optional.purpose: send thoughts across the Gauntlet
stir up elemental trouble in the Otherworlds
give a material object ephemeral power
drain Essence from a spirit
let another living being sense or contact spirits

name: Spirit 3: Pierce Gauntlet / Step Sideways / Rouse and Lull Spirit
summary: Step sideways into the Umbra on your own, wound spirits the way Life 3 wounds bodies, and wake up or lull to sleep the spirits within objects and places.
system: Taking normal clothes and gear along raises difficulty and needed successes by 1, bulky gear by 2. Taking other people or big objects needs a higher rank.

name: Spirit 4: Rend Gauntlet / Seal Breach / Bind Spirit
summary: Tear open or close gateways through the Gauntlet big enough for groups or large objects. Force spirits to show up, lock them into Fetishes, places or prisons, invite one into your own body, or drive one out of a possessed host.
system: Binding, channeling and exorcism are resisted rolls of your Willpower against the spirit's. While a spirit rides you, you use its powers but cannot use true magick. Opening or closing gateways is very vulgar.

name: Spirit 5: Forge Ephemera / Gilgul / Break the Dreamshell
summary: Create, reshape and destroy spirit-stuff: craft Realms, feed or drain a spirit's Essence, put a soul into an empty body or object, destroy a mage's Avatar (Gilgul), and break through to the Deep Umbra beyond the Horizon.
system: Always vulgar, with heavy consequences even on success. Breaking the Dreamshell takes at least 10 successes.

name: Time 1: Time Sense
summary: Get a perfect internal clock and notice the ripples that Time magick and other disturbances leave in the flow of time, before or after they happen.

name: Time 2: Past and Future Sight / Thicken the Walls of Time
summary: Catch brief, hazy glimpses of the past or future of the spot you stand on, limited to what someone there could have noticed. Or thicken time so other Time magick has a harder job.
system: Each thickening success removes one success from other characters' Time Effects. Add Matter, Life or Correspondence to read the past or future of an object, creature or other place.

name: Time 3: Time Contraction or Dilation / Bullet Time / Rewind Time
summary: Speed yourself up for extra actions, slow someone or something down, or wind back the last few moments around you to redo an action.
system: Every 2 successes give one extra action that is not magick (still only one Arete roll a turn). Each success slows a target one step (4 successes: a quarter speed). Rewinding goes back one turn per 2 successes. Going back in time adds +3 difficulty, is always vulgar and multiplies Paradox.

optional.purpose: affect energies
affect living beings
affect objects
cast Effects across distance and time
call up several probabilities at once

name: Time 4: Time Determinism / Trigger Effect / Time Bubble / Anchor Point
summary: Stand outside the usual current of time, hold an Effect until a set event triggers it, and with other Spheres trap beings or forces in a bubble of time. You can also set an anchor point to return to when you travel in time at rank 5.
system: A time bubble needs the Sphere of what it holds (Correspondence, Forces, Life, Matter or Spirit). Trapping something like a tornado is vulgar.

name: Time 5: Temporal Travel / Time Immunity
summary: Exist outside time, protect people, places or things from its passing, and travel forward or back through time.
system: Time travel is imprecise and largely up to the Storyteller; How Do You DO That? has the details.

name: Data 1: On the Ones and Zeros
summary: Technocratic Correspondence. Read the exact distances and connections between things you can see, and do basic work without instruments.
system: Data only reaches targets that are on the grid (electronic data and media).

name: Data 2: The Reach and the View
summary: With the right gear, see and touch what is happening elsewhere. Linked with other Spheres it gives Technocratic Effects range: Matter to tweak tech remotely, Mind to talk to anyone worldwide, Forces for remote strikes, Entropy for probability and flaws.
system: Your Data rank must be at least the highest rank in the linked Effect. How much data you need about the target depends on your rank (see the Data Connections chart).

name: Data 3: Quantum Teleportation / Firewalling / Surveillance Hub
summary: Send yourself by quantum teleportation, set up particle-physics firewalls that ward objects, places or people, and split your perceptions over many monitored locations. With other Spheres you can move things, energies and people across space.
system: Needs the proper gear at both ends.

name: Data 4: Between Space / Dimensional Cohabitation / Multilocation Access
summary: Open quantum gateways, build pocket dimensions, and spread holographic copies of yourself over several places. With Life, Mind and Primal Utility those copies become solid and can act on their own.

name: Data 5: Redistribute Physical Properties / Fold Space / Hyperdispersed Perceptions
summary: Stack locations into the same space, change a target's size and spatial properties, and spread your perceptions over so many places that you have eyes and ears everywhere.

name: Dimensional Science 1: EDE Scan / Evaluate Gauntlet / Map Dimensional Region
summary: Void Engineer Spirit. Detect extradimensional entities and coming incursions, measure the barrier and the nature of nearby dimensions, and map the terrain of pocket dimensions beyond it.

name: Dimensional Science 2: Dimensional Vibration / Modify Dimensional Gauntlet / Transdimensional Field
summary: Send ripples into nearby subdimensions to lure EDEs or signal other specialists, raise or lower the Gauntlet, and wrap yourself in a field that lets you briefly touch other dimensions without harm from the Dimensional Anomaly.
system: Unlike mystics, a specialist can drop the Gauntlet all the way to 0 for one scene, which shields everyone else from the Avatar Storm; the specialist still takes its damage.

name: Dimensional Science 3: Dimensional Shift / Manipulate Paraphysical Phenomena / Phase Disruption Field
summary: Shift sideways into other dimensions, handle their ephemera, and fire phase disruption fields that stun, hurt or disintegrate spirit entities.
system: Weapon settings let you pick bashing, lethal or aggravated damage against Umbral targets.

name: Dimensional Science 4: Alter Dimensional Topography / Dimensional Gateway / Stabilize Dimensional Field
summary: Make lasting changes to other dimensions, even from the Earthly side: pocket domains, walls to block or trap EDEs, fast travel routes, and large gateways. Protect people from Void Adaptation with Quintessence.
system: Fast routes divide Otherworld travel time by (successes + 1). Each point of Quintessence keeps one person safe from Void Adaptation for a week.

name: Dimensional Science 5: Anthropic Field / Breach Spatial Horizon / Cosmogenesis
summary: Project a reality bubble that lets you and others cross the Horizons into the Deep Universe, and engineer Horizon Constructs and custom EDE organisms.
system: The bubble carries two passengers per success beyond the second. Making EDEs also takes Primal Utility, and often Life and Matter if they must survive outside the subdimensions.

name: Primal Utility 1: Assess Primal Utility / Deposit Primal Utility / Exploit Primal Venture
summary: Syndicate Prime. See Quintessence flows, Resonance and magick at work around you, invest energy like Prime 1, and draw Quintessence from Ventures: businesses that act as Nodes for you.
system: A Venture's Node rating depends on its size, and you need a personal connection to it; each Primal Utility dot past the first lowers the connection needed by one step (see the Primal Ventures chart).

name: Primal Utility 2: Create Gadgets / Perfect Material Exploitation / Primal Innovation
summary: Use the normal Prime 2 Effects (adding value to materials, making something from nothing), always through some technological source.

name: Primal Utility 3: Create Stable Extraordinary Devices / Living-Asset Exploitation / Use Currency and Primal Storage
summary: Use Currency (Tass) and a well-run team to build permanent Devices, restore your own Pattern, and empty or recharge Devices and Matrices (Periapts).

name: Primal Utility 4: Create Tass / Exploit Opportunity / Liquidate Assets
summary: Turn free energy into Currency (money, credit cards, art, bonds), draw energy from exciting events, and destroy objects by stripping their value so nobody else can use it.
system: Only energy from Primal Utility activities can become Currency; you cannot charge it at an ordinary Node.

name: Primal Utility 5: Create Living Assets / Generate Primal Conflux and Ventures / Liquidate Living Assets / Market Compensation
summary: Work like a Prime Master: create permanent Devices, open new Nodes and Ventures, wipe out living beings, and cancel Market Correction (Paradox).

name: Resist a Marauder's Madness
summary: Shield your mind so a Marauder's contagious delusions do not take hold while you are near them.

name: Draw Others into Your Demesne
summary: Pull another person's consciousness into your personal dream realm. An unwilling guest stays trapped until they win their way out.
system: An unwilling target resists with a Willpower contest and may roll again every few turns to leave. Nothing physical is trapped, only the mind.

name: Absorb Quintessence: Node, Tass or Anywhere
summary: Take Quintessence into your Avatar: meditate at a Node for more than your usual limit, draw it out of Tass, or as a Master pull it from anywhere at all.
system: Without Prime 1, meditating at a Node draws no more than your Avatar rating. Your Avatar rating stays the most personal Quintessence you can hold. How much you absorb with magick follows the Base Damage or Duration chart.

combos.note: beyond your Avatar rating while meditating at a Node

name: Orchestrate a Car Crash
summary: Set up a chain of small coincidences, nudging objects and people without touching them, so they all collide into an accident. Inspired by Jacob in the film Ink.

optional.purpose: time everything to fall together

name: Slip Past the Cops by Luck
summary: Bend the odds so passing police overlook you, while you do something unremarkable like scratching graffiti into a wall.
system: Coincidental, difficulty 5. Back it up with a good Stealth roll.

source.section: Running With Magick: Example of Play

name: Extra Actions in Combat (Time 3)
summary: Speed up your own time so you can do several things in one turn without splitting your dice pool: draw and fire, reload and shoot, or attack and cast in the same moment.
system: Replaces the usual divided dice pool for multiple actions. A two-action maneuver, a crossbow that normally takes two turns, or a revolver reload can all fit into one turn. In a certamen duel you may use it for extra Gladius attacks, but slowing your rival with Time 3 breaks duel etiquette and loses the match on the spot.

source.section: Initiative and Movement: Doing Several Things at Once

name: Unweave a Living Pattern
summary: Tear at the Pattern that holds a living body together, so the wounds you deal are aggravated rather than merely lethal.
system: Aggravated damage cannot be soaked by ordinary flesh and heals slowly; only time and magick fix it.

name: Reweave Aggravated Wounds
summary: Restore a Pattern torn by fire, acid, fangs or magick, and mend the lasting damage that untreated injuries leave behind.
system: Each health level of aggravated damage healed costs one point of Quintessence. Fast healing like this is vulgar, even under a technological paradigm. Without Life 3 or real medical care, bad wounds leave a more or less permanent impairment.

name: Harden Skin to Block Blades
summary: Toughen your own skin so you can block swords, claws and other lethal attacks with your bare arms, which a normal human cannot do.
system: Some attacks, such as a running chainsaw, still cannot be blocked without losing the limb.

name: Stone-Shattering Fist Strike
summary: A martial arts punch that finds the weak spot with Entropy and smashes body and matter alike. The Life element makes the damage aggravated.
system: Cast through the martial arts practice: roll Arete or Enlightenment for the Effect and Dexterity + Martial Arts to land it, as one action. Damage comes from the Effect; in the book's example four successes gave eight health levels of aggravated damage.

name: Black Suit Aura of Authority
summary: A cold stare backed by theatrics plants one clear message in a target's mind: give up or die. Weak-willed foes simply fold.
system: Set up with an intimidating act first: each success on Manipulation + Intimidation lowers the casting difficulty by 1 (max -3, and never below 3).

name: Stability Integrity Matrix Scan
summary: Scan a foe or a structure for its weakest point, then aim your next strike there. Technocrats build it into their mirrorshades.
system: Each success lowers the difficulty of the next attack by 1, up to -3. It stacks nicely with a martial arts Death Strike or a Forces/Matter strike against an object.

name: Armor-Weave Clothing
summary: Rework a business suit, a dress or even lingerie so it protects like light armor while looking perfectly normal.
system: Enhanced clothing rates 1 to 5 as armor with no Dexterity penalty.

source.section: Combat System Charts: Armor and Shields

name: Ignore the Multiple-Opponent Penalty
summary: Keep a sensory Effect running in a melee so you always know who is doing what around you, even when several foes gang up on you.
system: Normally each extra close-range attacker adds +1 difficulty to attack and defense (max +4). With an active sensory Effect from one of these Spheres you ignore that penalty.

name: Soak a Spirit's Rage
summary: Use your knowledge of Spirit as countermagick to absorb the damage an angry spirit deals with its Rage.
system: Any rank of Spirit lets you soak Rage damage at difficulty 6. Without Spirit, a mage soaks with Avatar or Arete at difficulty 8; most mortals cannot soak it at all.

name: Fight an Unmaterialized Spirit
summary: Lay hands on a spirit that has not taken physical form, and with more skill hurt it the way Life magick hurts a body.
system: Spirit 2 lets you touch and grapple a spirit. To damage its ephemeral form you need Spirit 3. Life and Matter do nothing to spirits that never had a physical origin, and Mind attacks on them tend to backfire on the mage. Other Spheres only work if you enter the Umbra yourself.

optional.purpose: wound the spirit as Life 3 wounds a living body

source.section: The Otherworlds: Magick in the Otherworlds
Umbrood Spirit Entities: Spirits in Combat

name: Mend or Harm a Spirit's Form
summary: Combine Spirit and Prime to work on an Umbral entity the way Life magick works on flesh: heal its form, hurt it or reshape it.

name: Rend a Ghost's Essence with Entropy
summary: Strike at one of the Restless Dead with Entropy and Prime, which hits a ghost the way Life magick hits a living body. The price: it brings out the ghost's spectre, everything vicious about it.
system: In the Underworld, Entropy Effects get -2 difficulty but stir up the dark side of every ghost nearby.

source.section: The Otherworlds: Magick in the Otherworlds

name: Enchant a Weapon to Hit Spirits
summary: Charge a blade, bullet or fist so that it strikes ephemeral spirits instead of passing straight through them.

name: Forces-Boosted Throw
summary: Add a hidden push of kinetic energy to a thrown knife, mug or stone so it flies faster and hits harder.
system: Each success lowers the throw's difficulty by 1, to a maximum of -3, which also makes extra damage dice more likely.

name: Read an Opponent at a Distance
summary: Use a perception Effect to size up a fighter's intentions from farther than about 20 feet away, where the plain combat trick no longer works.
system: Reading an opponent is a resisted Perception + combat Trait roll against the target's Wits + combat Trait; each success adds a die to your next action.

name: Mass-Boosted Tackle
summary: Pump up your body mass or your momentum before slamming into someone, turning a bruising tackle into one that sends the target to hospital.
system: The tackle deals lethal damage instead of bashing. Throwing your frail human self at a cyborg or another mass-boosted body can do the same to you.

name: The Thunder Punch
summary: Charge a punch, kick or weapon blow with Enlightened power so it lands as a perfect, devastating strike. Pick whichever Sphere fits: aim, luck, speed, strength, a mental push or a Pattern attack.
system: Each success lowers the attack difficulty by 1, up to -3. Normally bashing; Pattern attacks with Life 3 or Prime 3 deal aggravated damage. If the target soaks all of it, the damage rebounds on you (bashing for Pattern attacks, possibly lethal against walls or steel).

combos.note: nudge probability to the perfect moment
boost Strength or hurt internally; aggravated

coincidentalIf: it looks like a perfectly executed strike; a blow far too strong for the mage's apparent build turns vulgar

name: See Through the Drunken Style
summary: Watch the flow of time during a fight to anticipate a drunken-style or Broken Rhythm fighter, cancelling the extra defense penalty that style imposes. Mind reading does not help, since the fighter does not know their next move either.

name: Bullet-Catch
summary: Added to the Arrow Cutting technique, this lets an Akashic snatch a bullet out of the air: Time quickens the reflexes, Forces bleeds off the bullet's energy, and Life hardens the skin.
system: You must know the shot is coming. Cast the Effect through Do, then roll Dexterity + Do as a dodge; beat the attacker's successes and you catch the bullet. Useless against shotgun blasts and automatic fire.
coincidentalIf: the local paradigm accepts superhuman martial artists; elsewhere it is vulgar

name: Endure Harsh Weather
summary: Tune your body to scorching desert, freezing cold or a howling storm so the weather stops wearing you down.
system: Protects against the bashing damage that brutal conditions deal every hour or so. Truly deadly settings (vacuum, crushing depth) and open flame need Life 3. Some extremes, like going naked in Antarctica, may still override it.

source.section: Environmental Hazards: Harsh Weather and Environments

name: Survive Vacuum, Pressure and Flame
summary: Protect a body against surroundings that kill outright: hard vacuum, deep-sea pressure, or standing in open fire.
system: Such places deal lethal damage, often every quarter hour; fire deals 1 to 3 aggravated levels a turn. Life 2 and Body Control do not stop flames. You may still suffer the heat, smoke and other side effects of a fire.

source.section: Environmental Hazards: Harsh Weather and Environments

name: Draw Quintessence from a Fire
summary: Fire turns matter into raw Quintessential chaos; a skilled mage can pull usable Quintessence out of a large blaze.
system: The amount follows the Base Damage or Duration chart. Fire's chaotic nature makes this hard even for masters.

name: Dodge the Blast
summary: When something explodes, bend luck, the elements, your body or the moment itself so you find just the right cover or roll at just the right time.
system: Optional rule. Reflexive: roll Dexterity (or Wits) + Arete at difficulty 6 for a grenade, 8 for a gas tank or IED, 9 with 3 successes needed for an artillery shell or truck bomb. Success halves the damage; 5 or more successes leave only cosmetic harm. Explosions that level buildings cannot be dodged this way. With a full action beforehand, higher ranks allow magickal shields or gateways out; Mind is useless here.
coincidentalIf: it looks like a lucky dive behind cover, a fall through the floor or a perfect roll

name: Structure-Shattering Kick
summary: A kick that cracks the integrity of a pillar, door or wall, focused through martial arts. Scanning for the weak spot first makes it far easier.
system: Damage-dealing Effects of Entropy, Matter or Prime lower an object's Durability by 2; Forces adds one automatic success of damage. Damage beyond Durability goes against Structure; more than twice the Structure wrecks the object. In the book's example six successes took down a Durability 6, Structure 6 pillar.

optional.purpose: find the weak spot first for up to -3 difficulty

name: Revive the Drowned or Suffocated
summary: Bring back someone who stopped breathing, as long as you reach them soon enough.
system: Life 3 works within the first few minutes. After about 10 minutes without air (30 in very cold water) the brain starts to deteriorate and only Life 5 will do.

combos.note: after the brain has started to deteriorate

name: Purge Poison, Drugs or Disease
summary: Clear a toxin, a drug or an illness out of a body instead of just easing the symptoms as ordinary medicine does.
system: A slow cure through an accepted remedy is usually coincidental; an instant cure is vulgar unless the patient and onlookers truly believe in miracles.

source.section: Environmental Hazards: Drugs, Poisons, and Disease

name: Inflict Intoxication or Disease
summary: Make someone drunk, high or sick through a touch, a drink or a curse.
system: Keep it subtle: a mild, believable effect passes, but someone who gets falling-down drunk from a handshake or catches leprosy from a pointed finger is clearly vulgar magick.

source.section: Environmental Hazards: Drugs, Poisons, and Disease
Environmental Hazards: Drugs, Poisons, and Disease

name: Shrug Off Toxic Clouds
summary: Protect yourself against tear gas, chlorine and other poison clouds that cannot be dodged.
system: Without gear or this Effect, a cloud deals its Toxin Rating every turn you stay in it. Some chemicals work through the skin, so holding your breath is not enough.

source.section: Environmental Hazards: Drugs, Poisons, and Disease

name: Awaken the Spirit of a Drug or Disease
summary: Rouse the spirit inside a drug, or inside a disease already in someone's body, through trance, ritual and invocation, making its effects stronger or gentler. It can also produce true mystic drugs.
system: With the right rituals this seems coincidental. Each Arete success adds one to the substance's Toxin Rating, and possibly to its other effects.

combos.note: a disease in someone else's body

name: Enhance a Drug or Microbe
summary: The lab approach to awakening substances: tweak a compound's molecules or a microbe's makeup to make it stronger, creating technomagickal drugs and diseases.
system: Done through lab work and proper procedures, it seems coincidental. Each Arete success adds one to the Toxin Rating, and possibly to its other effects.

combos.note: a substance inside a living body

name: Disperse or Spread a Toxic Cloud
summary: Steer the air so a gas cloud blows away from you, thins out, or drifts over your enemies instead.
system: Stronger Forces Effects move bigger clouds.

name: Make a Shot Ignite the Gas Tank
summary: Help a gunshot set off a vehicle's fuel tank, the classic movie explosion, as a coincidental Forces attack.
system: The shot needs at least three successes to hit and must deal six or more health levels before the fuel goes off. A car then explodes for about 12 dice of flaming aggravated damage; bigger vehicles do more.

source.section: The Technological World: Shooting the Gas Tank

name: Unconventional Machine Enhancement
summary: Upgrade a machine you build or tune with a little magick: advanced materials, a better power supply, sharper optics or a stronger shock. The item gets better but does not become a magickal item.
system: Coincidental Arete roll. Each success after the first adds one point of Durability or Structure, or one damage die per two successes, or a story quality such as paint that never scratches.

combos.note: boost an energy device such as a Taser

name: Astral Immersion in the Digital Web
summary: Project your senses and sense of self into the Digital Web through good VR gear, leaving your body in a deep trance at home.
system: Needs VR gear (a good smartphone or tablet will do) and an Intelligence + Computer roll, difficulty 7 (6 with the Data option), three successes. Online, Intelligence stands in for Strength and Wits for Dexterity. You can drop out at once, but your body is helpless while you are away. Coincidental.

name: Holistic Immersion in the Digital Web
summary: Have a Trinary computer break your body down into data and download all of you into the Digital Web, physically present with your normal Traits.
system: Extended Intelligence + Computer roll, difficulty 7 (Data does not help), five successes, 30 seconds per roll. Any interruption triggers an immediate Paradox backlash. Damage online is real, and dying there means dying.

name: Popping and Backspacing
summary: Jump from one Web sector to another, or hop back to where you just were, usually with a pop prog that scans and logs the destination first.
system: Scan one turn, pop the next; popping blind is +2 difficulty. No pop prog is needed to return within a minute or two. Popping into or out of Restricted space is difficulty 8 or 9 and vulgar, and failure there means icon death or a chaos dump. A failed pop lands you somewhere awkward; a botch can soft de-rez you.
coincidentalIf: both locations are in the same sector; popping between sectors is vulgar

source.section: The Digital Web: Popping and Backspacing

name: Step Sideways into the Umbra
summary: Turn yourself into ephemera and walk bodily through the Gauntlet into the spirit world, or tear a gateway so others can follow.
system: Extended Arete roll against the local Gauntlet: from difficulty 3 and one success at a Node to difficulty 9 and five successes in a Technocracy lab. A botch leaves you stuck between worlds. You keep your Traits and can see spirits, but need Spirit magick to affect the physical world. High-tech gear may fail on the other side. With the Avatar Storm optional rule, each crossing costs Paradox + Arete dice of damage.

combos.note: open a gateway others can use

name: Astral Travel Through the Otherworlds
summary: Leave your body in a trance and fly as pure consciousness, tied home by a silver cord, through the material world, the Periphery and the High Umbra.
system: Arete roll against the local Gauntlet. Manipulation serves as Strength, Wits as Dexterity, Intelligence as Stamina, and damage costs Willpower; losing all of it snaps the cord. Immune to the Avatar Storm. Beyond the Penumbra into the Middle Umbra needs the Astral Sojourn's body of light. Usually coincidental, since onlookers only see someone meditating.

optional.purpose: leap past the Horizon into the Deep Umbra

source.section: The Otherworlds: Example of Umbral Travel
Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Bind an Object to Your Astral Form
summary: Ritually tie a possession to yourself so it comes along when you travel astrally, instead of arriving empty-handed and naked.
system: Spend a Willpower point and get at least five Arete successes. The object should not outweigh you, and anything that relies on complex physics, like a gun or a computer, probably will not work there.

name: Astral Sojourn Ritual
summary: While in a helpless trance, weave yourself a body of light out of Quintessence and ephemera, then step sideways in it to reach any layer of the living Otherworlds.
system: The light-body has your normal Attributes and health levels. If it loses them all it falls apart and your consciousness is left adrift in the Umbra. Either rank of Mind works.

name: Snap an Astral Traveler's Silver Cord
summary: A direct psychic attack that cuts an astral traveler off from the body left behind.
system: Resisted roll, both sides at the target's Willpower as difficulty; you need more successes. The victim can spend a Willpower point to grab the cord and ride it home; otherwise they drift.

name: Astral Beacon
summary: Light a guiding signal near the body of a lost astral traveler so their drifting mind can find the way home.
system: Lasts one day per success. The traveler rolls Perception or Wits + Occult or Meditation at difficulty 9 minus your successes. A drifting soul has one week per point of permanent Willpower before it fades for good.

name: Drifting Soul Possesses a Body
summary: A lost astral traveler takes over someone else's body as a new home.
system: You must overcome the target's Willpower. If the body is on the other side of the Gauntlet, you first need to be able to see it.

combos.note: body on your side of the Gauntlet

name: Keep Watch on Your Body While Astral
summary: Keep a sensory link to your entranced body while you travel astrally, so you notice if someone comes for it.

name: Agama Sojourn
summary: Die a little: split your soul between life and death and enter the Shadowlands as ghostly ephemera while your body lies clinically dead. A Euthanatos initiation, and a very dangerous trip.
system: The Agama Re rite takes yourself through; the Agama Te rite sends someone else and keeps them tethered for the return. The traveler's corpus has 10 health levels and no wound penalties; Life magick does not affect it. Losing all of it means a permanent point of Jhor and a Harrowing.

name: Heal an Agama Corpus
summary: Repair the ghostly body of a living mage on an Agama Sojourn. Life magick cannot touch it, since its life stayed behind in the flesh.

name: Shield of the Soul
summary: Ask your familiar or totem to wrap your spirit inside its own so you cross the Avatar Storm under its protection.
system: Optional Avatar Storm rule. With the Shield in place, Storm damage is rolled on your Paradox alone, not Paradox + Arete. The spirit must be friendly toward you on both ends of the trip.

name: Bridge of Blood
summary: A despised rite: stuff a captive spirit with your own Quintessence and drag it through the Gauntlet as a decoy for the Avatar Storm to devour while you step sideways.
system: Needs at least one success per dot of your Avatar Background and puts all of your Quintessence into the spirit. Other mages and spirits take a very dim view of it.

name: Carry Items into the Shadowlands
summary: Soak an item in Entropic energy and bind it to yourself, so it travels with you on an Agama Sojourn instead of staying behind with your body.
system: The binding uses the same Prime 2 ritual as for astral travel: a Willpower point and at least five Arete successes.

name: Agama Travel Beyond the Underworld
summary: Climb out of the Low Umbra into other layers while on an Agama Sojourn: either open a gate from the Shadowlands to the Middle Umbra, or raise your dead consciousness astrally into the Vulgate of the High Umbra.
system: Needs the normal Agama Sojourn ranks as well. No other kind of traveler can move between the Underworld and the other layers like this.

combos.note: gateway to the Middle Umbra; Life 2 from the Agama rite
astral rise to the High Umbra; Spirit 3 and Life 2 from the Agama rite

name: Find the Old Roads
summary: A Verbena secret: search near a Node for an entrance to the Paths of the Wyck, the Old Roads that bypass the Avatar Storm.
system: Only for trusted, trained Verbena. The Arete roll uses the local Gauntlet as difficulty. Often there is nothing to find, or the path dead-ends; three or more successes should turn up a path that matters.

source.section: The Otherworlds: Verbenae and the Old Roads

name: Cross a Pericarp Between Realms
summary: Step sideways through the Pericarp, the Gauntlet-like barrier between one Realm and the next.
system: Some Realms may demand another Sphere, such as Mind, Forces or Time, instead of Spirit.

source.section: The Otherworlds: Magick in the Otherworlds

name: Bind a Spirit in a Fetish or Pentacle
summary: Imprison a spirit: seal a slumbering one into a Fetish, or trap a materialized one in a pentacle or hypertech spirit cage so it cannot roam.
system: A Fetish stays unusable until the bound spirit has regained its full Essence. Most spirits deeply resent being imprisoned, and they live a very long time.

name: Exorcism of a Possessing Umbrood
summary: Drive a demon or other possessing entity out of the person or object it has taken over.
system: Once a Possession has taken hold it usually lasts until the spirit leaves; exorcism or True Faith are the ways to break it.

name: Adapt to Environment
summary: Change a body so it copes with a hostile setting: breathe underwater, shrug off cold or heat, survive thin air.

name: Cause or Cure Disease
summary: Make a living body sick or drive an illness out of it.

name: Cosmetic Alteration
summary: Change looks without changing what the body can do: hair, eye or skin color, features, scars, tattoos.

name: Create a Living Body
summary: Build a living body out of raw Quintessence: easy for something simple like a plant or insect, a Master's work for a complex creature.

name: Duplicate a Body
summary: Make a physical copy of a living body, such as a clone.

name: Grow New Limbs or Other Features
summary: Regrow a lost limb or add new body parts and features, like claws, gills or an extra arm.

name: Heal or Harm a Living Being
summary: Mend injuries in a living body, or damage it directly by twisting its Pattern.
system: Health levels healed or inflicted follow the damage chart (two levels for two successes, more after). Life damage is aggravated.

name: Heal or Harm a Fae
summary: Heal or injure one of the fae, whose bodies blend flesh with dream-stuff.

name: Heal or Harm a Vampire
summary: Heal or injure a vampire, whose undead body sits between living tissue and dead matter.

name: Heal or Harm a Werecreature
summary: Heal or injure a shapeshifter, whose body is bound up with spirit.

name: Increase Physique or Physical Traits
summary: Make a body stronger, tougher or quicker by boosting its Physical Attributes.

name: Rot a Body
summary: Make living flesh decay and wither, either through entropy or by attacking the life Pattern directly.

name: Sleep Spell
summary: Put someone to sleep, either by nudging their mind toward drowsiness or by forcing their body to drop off at once.

name: Soak Aggravated Damage
summary: Toughen your body so you can soak aggravated damage that normally cannot be soaked.

name: Transform a Body into an Element
summary: Turn a living body into an element such as stone, water, fire or air. Higher ranks make the change more thorough.

name: Alter Probability
summary: Tip the odds of a chance event your way; more rank lets you push bigger or less likely outcomes.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Fate and Fortune

name: Cause Decay
summary: Make an object age, rust, rot or fall apart faster than it should; more rank speeds it up further.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Fate and Fortune

name: Spot Weakness
summary: See the flaw or weak point in an object, a defense, a plan or a person.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Fate and Fortune

name: Craft a Device
summary: Build a permanent technological Wonder that holds an Effect.
system: Needs Prime 4 plus the Spheres of every Effect the Device performs. Rules for Wonders are in M20 Appendix II.

name: Craft a Fetish
summary: Bind a spirit into an object so the object can use its powers.

name: Craft a Periapt or Matrix
summary: Make a permanent store for Quintessence out of an object or a living being.

name: Craft a Talisman
summary: Make a permanent mystic Wonder that holds an Effect.
system: Needs Prime 4 plus the Spheres of every Effect the Talisman performs.

name: Craft a Trinket
summary: Make a small magickal item: consecrate it with Prime, or give it its special quality with whatever Sphere fits.

name: Bless or Curse a Spirit
summary: Give a spirit or ephemeral being good or bad fortune.

name: Command a Spirit
summary: Force a spirit to obey your orders.

name: Conjure a Spirit
summary: Call a spirit to come to you.

name: Drain a Spirit's Essence
summary: Pull the Essence out of a spirit, weakening it and taking its power.

name: Harm a Ghost
summary: Injure a wraith or other ghost, either through death-magick backed by Prime or directly through its spirit form.

name: Harm a Spirit
summary: Damage a spirit's ephemeral body the way Life 3 damages a living one.

name: Open or Close a Gateway to the Umbra
summary: Tear a passage through the Gauntlet that others can use, or seal one shut.

name: See Spirits
summary: Perceive spirits and the spirit world beyond the Gauntlet.

name: Speak to Spirits
summary: Talk with spirits across the Gauntlet.

name: Touch a Spirit
summary: Make brief physical contact with a spirit on the other side of the Gauntlet.

name: Call a Storm
summary: Summon a storm out of the sky; more Forces makes it bigger and wilder.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Conjure a New Object
summary: Create a physical object out of thin air; more complex objects need more Matter.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Disintegrate an Object
summary: Reduce an object to dust, either by aging it to ruin in moments or by tearing its material apart.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Invisibility or Silence Field
summary: Bend light or sound around an object or area so it cannot be seen or heard.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Make a Living Being Invisible
summary: Make a person or animal invisible by locking light-bending into their body.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Consecrate, Harden or Perfect an Object
summary: Make an object tougher, flawless or bound to your energy, by reworking its material or charging it with Quintessence.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Levitation or Flight
summary: Float or fly by pushing against gravity with Forces, or by shifting your body through space with Correspondence and Life. Matter 2 on its own lightens and floats objects.

combos.note: push against gravity; more rank for more speed and weight

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Speed Up or Slow Down an Object
summary: Change how fast something moves: stop a bullet, hurl a stone, slow a falling body.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Transform an Object
summary: Change an object into something else; turning it into an energy or a living thing also needs that Sphere.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Transform an Energy
summary: Turn one force into another (light into heat, sound into electricity), or into matter or life with that Sphere added.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Affect a Distant Object or Being
summary: Cast an Effect on someone or something that is not here, by linking to it through space.
system: The Correspondence Sphere Ranges chart sets the successes needed by how well you know the target. The linked Effect can go no higher than your Correspondence rank.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Age or Rejuvenate
summary: Make a living being or an object age fast, or turn back its age.
system: Running time backwards is always vulgar and costs +3 difficulty.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Conjure an Earthly Being
summary: Bring a living creature from somewhere else on Earth to you through space.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Create Multiple Images
summary: Show copies of yourself or something else in several spots, either by bending space or by shaping light.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Create Multiple Copies of an Object
summary: Make one object exist several times over.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Open a Gateway Between Locations
summary: Open a gate through space that people and things can walk through.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Set a Time Trigger
summary: Cast an Effect now and hang it in time until a moment or event you choose sets it off.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Ward or Ban
summary: Protect a place against a chosen kind of being or energy, or ban it from entering. The Sphere of whatever you keep out goes into the ward.
system: HDYDT pp. 95-104 has the detailed ward rules.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Time and Distance

name: Astral Body of Light
summary: Give your projected mind a glowing body of its own while you travel astrally.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Clairvoyance
summary: See or hear what is happening at a distant place, or through a distant person's mind.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Conceal or Alter an Aura
summary: Hide your aura or make it show something other than what you really feel or are.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Conceal Your Avatar
summary: Hide the signs of your Awakened soul from those who look for them.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Conceal Your Thoughts
summary: Keep your thoughts hidden from mind-readers.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Influence the Subconscious
summary: Plant ideas, urges or doubts below someone's conscious awareness.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Prophecy or Hindsight
summary: Look into the future or the past, either as a raw glimpse of time or as visions filtered through the mind.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Scramble Thoughts
summary: Jumble someone's thinking so they cannot concentrate or think straight.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: See Someone's Avatar
summary: Look past the body and mind to see a person's Avatar, and so tell whether they are Awakened.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: See Through Another's Eyes
summary: Ride along on someone else's senses and perceive what they perceive.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: See Through Mental Illusions
summary: Recognize illusions planted in your mind and see what is really there.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Sense Energies
summary: Pick up the kind of energy or Pattern a Sphere covers with rank 1 of that Sphere: space, probability, forces, life, matter, minds, Quintessence, spirits, time.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Share Perceptions
summary: Let other people perceive what your Sphere senses show you.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Shield a Mind
summary: Raise a mental barrier against mind-reading and psychic attack.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Telepathy
summary: Talk mind to mind.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Telekinesis
summary: Move things without touching them by pushing on them with force; more rank lifts more.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Translate Languages
summary: Understand a language you do not know; with Forces, also make your words understood by others.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Absorb Quintessence
summary: Take Quintessence into your own Pattern from a Node, Tass or other source.

name: Drain a Node
summary: Empty a Node of its stored Quintessence.

name: Drain Quintessence
summary: Siphon Quintessence out of an object, Effect or Pattern.

name: Fuel a New Pattern
summary: Supply the Quintessence that any conjured energy, matter or life needs to exist; pair it with the Sphere of what you make.

name: Share or Exchange Quintessence
summary: Pass Quintessence to another mage or trade it back and forth.

name: Weave a Simple Body of Light
summary: Project a glowing image of yourself made of energy. It is only a body: it cannot be used for astral travel.

name: Pull Small Things Through Space
summary: Reach through a tiny hole in space and pull a small object or creature, no bigger than a house cat, from somewhere else into your hand. Think of a card, a gun or a rabbit appearing out of nowhere.

name: Move Things at a Distance
summary: Levitate, handle or teleport an object, force or creature without touching it, by working on the space between you and it.

name: Co-location: Be in Several Places at Once
summary: Appear in several places at the same time. Without more magick every copy copies your movements; add Life so each self can act on its own.

optional.purpose: each copy acts independently

name: See Many Places at Once
summary: Spread your senses over many different places at the same time, far beyond the few overlapping views of Correspondence 3.

name: Attract or Repel Forces
summary: Make an object or creature push away, or draw in, a chosen kind of energy: a small protective field against it, or a magnet for it.

name: Turn a Person into Electricity
summary: Transform a living being into pure electrical energy.

name: Turn Water into Air
summary: Change a material substance into an energetic or gaseous one, such as turning water into air.

name: Make Things Fly or Pin Them Down
summary: Bind a force like gravity or lift to a body or object, so it flies, floats, or gets pinned to the ground.

name: Turn Matter into Living Tissue
summary: Change lifeless material into something alive, from wine into blood up to building living tissue out of dead matter.

combos.note: a simple substance such as blood

name: Turn a Creature into an Object
summary: Transform something alive into an inanimate object, fairy-tale style: a pumpkin into a carriage, a person into a throne, a vampire into lawn furniture.

combos.note: simple organisms such as a pumpkin
the book's Matter 5 example: a vampire into lawn furniture

name: Switch Minds Between Bodies
summary: Move someone's mind into another body.

name: Consecrate a Living Being
summary: Bind a living creature to your personal energy the way Prime 1 binds an object, so it shifts with you when your Pattern changes.

name: Enchant a Living Being
summary: Charge a living creature with Quintessence so it can deal or withstand aggravated damage, or rattle its life force to wound it with aggravated damage.

name: Draw Quintessence from a Sacrifice or an Object
summary: Pull a little life energy out of a living sacrifice, or Quintessence out of a lifeless object.

name: Craft a Soulgem
summary: Pour your own Quintessence into a Periapt to make a Soulgem: a portable store filled with your energy and Resonance.

source.section: Energy-Work: Creating Soulgems, Soulflowers, and Assets

name: Create a Soulflower
summary: Turn a complex living being into a Soulflower: a walking Periapt that stores a boosted supply of Quintessence.

source.section: Energy-Work: Creating Soulgems, Soulflowers, and Assets

name: Read Spiritual Energies
summary: Sense and interpret Resonance, Synergy and other spirit energies, such as a spirit's Essence or its place in a hierarchy.

name: Make Objects from Ephemera
summary: Build a short-lived physical object out of spirit-stuff. You make it as if it were a real material thing, and it fades when the Effect ends.

name: Pick Out the Likeliest Future
summary: Scan several possible futures side by side and tell which of them is the most probable.

name: Rewind Time and Keep Your Memories
summary: Go back in time while still remembering what happened in the future you just left.

source.section: Time Distortion and Travel: Rewinding Time

name: Change Your Hair Color by Magick
summary: Turn your own hair from one color to another, say brown to blue, by working on your body's Pattern instead of reaching for dye.
system: A minor cosmetic change to yourself needs only one success.

name: Conjure a Fireball or Pulse-Cannon Blast
summary: Create a destructive burst of energy out of nothing: a hypertech pulse-cannon shot, or a fireball. Forces shapes the element and Prime supplies the energy. A Black Suit might do it with a lighter and a can of hairspray instead of a staff.
system: The focus has to fit the caster's beliefs; the same Spheres work through very different tools.

name: Conjure a Small Object into Your Pocket
summary: Produce a small item, like a flask, a business card or a pocket pistol, from a pocket that was not proven empty. The thing has to come from somewhere: either build it from nothing or fetch it from where it really is.
system: Making it from thin air takes several successes. The object must fit where it appears; a big gun from a tiny pocket does not pass as coincidence.

combos.note: move a real one from elsewhere

name: Hail a Taxi by Magick
summary: Get a real cab to come to you: find one nearby, nudge its driver your way and bend the odds so it shows up. With luck alone it works too, but slowly.
system: With Entropy alone you need lots of successes outside a busy city, and you may still wait a while. A teleport followed by a lucky taxi does not count; the process has to explain the result.

combos.note: find a cab and steer its driver to you
just tilt the odds and wait

name: Conjure a Taxi and Its Driver from Nothing
summary: Build a working car, engine and all, plus a capable human driver, out of thin air. Possible in theory, but a huge undertaking that shows why mages rarely try such things.
system: Needs several dots in Crafts and Science (Biology, Human Anatomy) with many successes on those rolls, then 20 to 30 successes on the Effect at difficulty 9 (10 near people), never below 6. A botch can be catastrophic.

name: Draw the Tarot Card You Need
summary: Bend chance so the card you want comes up in a reading, using magick to help a mundane task rather than replace it.
system: Each success on the Arete roll cuts the difficulty of the related Attribute + Ability roll by 1, to at most -3. The casting roll itself can be lowered with Quintessence as usual.

name: Scatter a Body Across Space
summary: Teleport a person to several destinations at the same time, tearing them apart. One of the few ways Correspondence does harm, together with dropping someone somewhere deadly.
system: Usually aggravated damage.

name: Make Any Magickal Attack Aggravated
summary: Charge an attack of any Sphere with Quintessence so its damage becomes aggravated: a psychic blast that would only bruise, a stone or spirit strike that would only cut.
system: Costs a point of Quintessence. Mind attacks are normally bashing, Matter and Spirit attacks lethal. Combined Spheres use the most harmful damage type, they do not add up.

name: Strike a Faraway Target (Blow Up the Moon)
summary: Hit a target as remote as the moon with a massive energy attack. Correspondence limits how strong a linked Effect can be, so a long-range assault this big needs Correspondence as high as the Forces behind it.
system: Forces 5 with only Correspondence 2 cannot do it. Needs a great many successes.

name: Protective Countermagick: Dispel or Reflect
summary: Step in to block a spell aimed at someone else, or throw an attack back at the mage who cast it. You need to understand one of the attacking Spheres and fuel the defense with Prime.
system: Full action and 1 Quintessence; you also need a dot in a Sphere the attack uses. Basic countermagick is Arete at difficulty 7; dispelling is +1, reflecting +2. Each success cancels one of the attacker's; when reflecting, every success beyond the caster's roll hits the caster.

combos.note: plus 1 dot in a Sphere the attack uses

name: Anti-Magick: Harden Reality
summary: Use your own Prime energy to stiffen local reality so a Deviant's spells get harder to cast. A favorite Technocratic tactic, also used by some mystics.
system: Full turn. Roll your Prime rating at difficulty 8. Every success raises the opposing mage's casting difficulty by 1 and costs you 1 Quintessence.

name: Unweave an Existing Effect
summary: Untangle a spell that is already in place, such as a curse, ward, gateway, trigger or transformation, through a ritual that unpicks the original caster's work.
system: Needs Prime plus a dot in every Sphere of the original Effect. Roll at countermagick difficulty +1 to overcome each of its successes; long-standing Effects need 10 or more, major creations 20+. Spend at least as much Quintessence as went into it. Gilgul, instant damage, sensory magick and Horizon Realm creation cannot be unwoven.

combos.note: plus 1 dot in each Sphere of the original Effect

name: Nullify Paradox with Stored Quintessence
summary: Bank Quintessence in a symbol or Periapt tied to your body or to a working, then release it when Paradox gathers so the two energies cancel out.
system: Pool the Quintessence and cast the Effect: each point wipes out one point of Paradox. Whatever is left over acts or stays on the wheel as usual.

name: Cure Another Mage's Quiet
summary: Help a fellow mage out of Quiet by driving the Paradox out of their mind, paying for it with your own life energy. Expect heavy roleplaying and social or Knowledge rolls alongside the magick.
system: An extended roll. As a guide, replace each point of Paradox in the patient's pool with 2 or 3 points of your own Quintessence. Meant to be hard.

name: Enter a Mad Mage's Mindscape
summary: Travel into the private dreamworld where a mage lost in Quiet is trapped, to help guide them back. Once inside, you face its terrors too.
system: Takes a few successes, and only if the Storyteller allows it. Mind 5 astral travel works as well. Damage taken inside is bashing; being killed there may mean real death or a coma.

name: Luck into a Free Lunch
summary: While panhandling, tilt the odds so someone offers you a meal: spot the hungry, kindly passersby and read auras to pick one who wants nothing in return. Jinx's card-dealing example.
system: Coincidental, difficulty 5 (Entropy 2 + 3), -1 for a personal instrument. One success is enough. A good Charisma roll first can cut the difficulty further.

source.section: Examples in Play: Coincidental Mystic Effect

name: Trans-Temporal Warp Drive Getaway
summary: Make a souped-up car outrun pursuit: skip it through space past traffic, push it faster than it should go, handle the physics and keep it from shaking apart. Dr. von Roth's Aston Martin example.
system: Base difficulty 7 (Correspondence 4 + 3), -2 for a unique personalized instrument, -1 for a point of Quintessence.
coincidentalIf: focused through a vehicle the mage has engineered for it, and only barely

name: Prime-Charged Bullets
summary: Fire a gun loaded with special ammo that carries an Effect into the target: more velocity and harm, and aggravated damage that hurts even a werewolf. Bruce Foster's example.
system: Coincidental, difficulty 5. Roll the attack separately; one Arete roll covers all shots that turn. Forces adds one success of damage, so 2 successes mean 6 health levels, made aggravated by Prime.

source.section: Examples in Play: Targeted Damage Effect

name: Ward a Home Against Spies and Intruders
summary: Ritually protect your home: thicken space against remote spying, tie the Effect into the building itself, push a quiet go-away feeling at anyone who comes near, and get a mental alarm if someone breaks in. Nix's ritual example.
system: A ceremony of about 7 successes over several hours, difficulty 5 before Quintessence. Every success is taken off anyone spying with Correspondence. Lasts until you take it down.
coincidentalIf: the wards stay subtle; if they flare up or do something obvious the Effect is vulgar

source.section: Examples in Play: Extended Roll Ritual

name: Moyo Kizungu: Speaking the Heart
summary: An old honesty spell, here mixed with digital data: reach your targets from afar and push them to blurt out their worst secrets at the worst moments. Malcolm's divided-successes example against public figures.
system: Correspondence caps the Effect, so Mind stays at 2 with Correspondence 2. The example spends 17 successes (a Great Work) on base, six targets, a one-story duration and range from personal data, at difficulty 5.

source.section: Examples in Play: Divided Successes Option
Examples in Play: Divided Successes Option

name: Freeze a Fight in a Time Bubble
summary: Stop time around a group of people so you can pull a victim out of danger before anyone moves again. Aria's example.
system: At least 5 successes for three people. In front of Sleepers the difficulty is 9; one success beyond what was needed kept them frozen for the rest of the scene. Earns Paradox even on success.

source.section: Examples in Play: Vulgar Magic Effect

name: Mend a Broken Leg
summary: Heal another person's broken bone. A shaman and a Progenitor doctor manage it equally well with the same Sphere rank; the practice is only the method.

name: Turn an Enemy into a Newt
summary: Transform a person into a small animal. Whether a mage does it with a glare or a transmutation ray depends entirely on their focus.

name: Harden Armor Against Aggravated Damage
summary: Invest Quintessence into a suit of armor so it also protects against aggravated harm.
system: One point of Quintessence.

name: Pull Strings for Fast Transport
summary: Use corporate or political clout to get somewhere far away fast: one call and a helicopter is waiting, and hours later you are in the meeting that matters. Magick through management.
system: Needs 3 or more dots in at least two suitable social Backgrounds and a concept that lets you give orders. Slow and indirect, but safe.

source.section: Focus and the Arts: Management and HR

name: Black Card / Little Black Box
summary: Plug a little black box or swipe a card into one part of a security system and watch the locks open, even ones you could never reach directly, as long as they share a network. The classic movie hacking trick, made real.
system: You still need to hack the system with the proper rolls (Hacking, M20 p. 403). The gadget makes what would be vulgar coincidental.

name: Hot-Shotting
summary: Tweak your weapon so its cocking, click or draw sounds ominous and hits harder. The noise and the extra kick can be used to scare a target into giving up, hurt them more, or hit several of them.
system: A Crafts roll modifies the weapon. Each success gives -1 difficulty on your next attack plus one automatic Forces success, spent on intimidation, damage, extra targets or a mix (Dividing Successes, p. 538).

optional.purpose: make the sound itself a threat: roll against the target's Willpower, and if your successes match or beat it they surrender

name: Hands of Death
summary: Hit with bare hands and feet hard enough to break planks, punch through walls and cripple a foe, through martial training, cybernetics or anatomy know-how. Forces adds impact, Life aims at the body's Pattern.
system: Strikes use the Damage or Duration chart, plus one automatic success for Forces. Coincidental blows are not aggravated, but a truly theatrical (usually vulgar) one can be.

optional.purpose: find weak points: each success lowers armor, Durability or soak by one (not vulgar)
charge your fists with chi for aggravated damage (vulgar)

name: Right-Click
summary: Focus a mental cursor on a person, place or thing and get a readout of what the databases know about it: name, stats, posts, photos and more, plus their current location if they keep checking in online. Works only on what is actually stored somewhere.
system: Needs a data-linked instrument (implant, phone, VDAS). Successes set the depth: 1 surface data up to 5 classified files, 6+ anything that exists. Each extra vision mode beyond the first is +1 difficulty to perception rolls. The data may be wrong.

optional.purpose: ultraviolet and infrared vision
see health and body heat
scan an object's physical makeup
X-ray vision
see Quintessence flows
look up spirits in a database of entities (Storyteller's option)
use it from the Otherworlds

name: Hypernarrative Influence
summary: Use a stock movie line, archetype or trope to make someone slip into a familiar story role (the hero, the sidekick, the enemy who becomes an ally) and play it out, unless they notice the cliche.
system: A Manipulation + Art or Expression roll triggers the behavior, usually for one scene; buy more Duration to keep a role going. A failure, botch or savvy target breaks the spell.

optional.purpose: tilt events to fit the story (guns run dry, cars explode); the Storyteller picks the twist

coincidentalIf: the target knows mass-media tropes, which nearly everyone does

name: Sanitize Evidence
summary: A cleanup squad's Procedure: repair the damage, destroy bodies, blood and bullet holes, and turn the waste into energy so nothing is left to alarm the Masses.
system: Extended roll, one hour of work per roll; each success turns 10 pounds of matter into energy. Teams split big jobs, and other agents keep the scene clear. A botch brings Paradox right away, often as an explosion or meltdown.

name: Secure the Scene
summary: Seal off an incident site with tape and hazard signs that push people away, while scanners pick up blood, gunpowder and other traces for later cleanup. Cloaking projectors can also black out light and sound.
system: At least 3 successes, 5+ for big areas. Getting in takes a Willpower roll beating the operative's successes. Scanning gives -1 to Perception + Alertness rolls for evidence. The blackout adds 3 successes to the total.

combos.note: people feel they should avoid the area

optional.purpose: blackout field: the area looks dark and silent from outside (vulgar unless already dark)

coincidentalIf: without the blackout field, or with it only in near or total darkness

name: Dimension Bomb
summary: Phase a calibrated grenade or other explosive through the Gauntlet so it goes off on the other side, among whatever is waiting to come through.
system: Difficulty is the Gauntlet rating. A failure or botch can leave the bomb stuck between worlds, hurting both sides. With the Forces add-on, every success not needed to get through becomes Forces damage.

optional.purpose: use the bomb as the focus for a Forces explosion; more Forces makes it bigger

name: Golden Gunman
summary: Action-movie gunplay with two pistols or two blades: flips, huge leaps, no recoil, and attacks at several enemies at once.
system: Time lets you act with both hands without the usual multiple-action penalties; roll each attack normally. A botch or backlash brings spectacular movie-style mishaps.

name: Social Conditioning
summary: Isolate a subject and reshape their loyalties through intensive indoctrination and Mind Procedures, from willing convert up to total devotion over ten stages. Only an organized group with resources can do it.
system: Initial processing: Arete vs the target's Willpower + 3; each success strips a temporary Willpower point, and at zero the subject reaches stage 1. Each later stage needs one success on an extended resisted roll (difficulty 6) against the subject's permanent Willpower, one roll per day for PsychOps.

optional.purpose: reinforce the programming in the later stages

name: Break Your Own Social Conditioning
summary: Fight off programming that was put into your mind by working magick on yourself.
system: Spend a Willpower point first. Each success removes one stage of Conditioning for the scene; 5 or more breaks it for good.

name: The Bullet-Catch (Akashic Rote)
summary: An Akashic trick for snatching bullets out of the air: slow the round, toughen your skin and speed your reflexes.
system: Added to the Arrow Cutting feat (p. 428) and focused through Do. You must know the attack is coming; roll Dexterity + Do as a dodge, and if you beat the attacker's successes you catch the bullets.
coincidentalIf: in a region that accepts superhuman martial arts

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: Awaken the Inanimate
summary: Wake the sleeping spirit of an object or place by giving it attention and a share of your own Resonance. An awakened thing works better for you, does you small favors, and also exists in the Umbra, so it can travel there with you.
