system: An extended ritual: about 5 successes for small things, 20 or more for big areas or complex machines. Asking for clearly impossible favors can make it vulgar.

optional.purpose: also lower the Gauntlet of an awakened house

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes
Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: Chain of Whispers
summary: Tell a scandalous secret to a friend and beg them to keep it; the spell makes them pass it on, and each new listener feels the same itch. Today a call, text or post works as well as a whisper.
system: Each success makes two people share it; ordinary gossip carries it on after the spell fades. A simple Willpower roll resists, though few bother.
coincidentalIf: the secret is not obviously ridiculous or easy to disprove

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: Penny Dreadful's Bright New Penny
summary: Look back at what a piece of junk once was and restore it to mint condition, or rebuild it entirely. Hollowers and street kids use it to find pristine antiques in unlikely places.
system: Simple, battered items are easy; elaborate restorations or full recreations take 3 or more successes.

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: Psychic Interface
summary: Enter a light trance and work on computer data with your mind alone: read and change it, run IT systems, surge or short out a network, maybe talk to data entities. Technoshamans reach the machine through its spirits instead.
system: Needs Computer 4 with a Psychic Interface specialty and Meditation 3; meditation can then replace computer gear as an instrument. Quietly hacking from afar is coincidental; making a machine across the room explode is vulgar, and so is entering the Digital Web.

combos.note: also project yourself into the Digital Web
through computer spirits instead of Data
through computer spirits, into the Digital Web

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes
Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: Talons
summary: Grow claws by stretching and hardening finger bones, or graft steel and other materials into the limbs as cybernetic blades.
system: Claws do lethal damage and allow the Claw maneuver (Chapter Nine).

optional.purpose: work steel or other materials into the claws
toughen the claws so they deal aggravated damage

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes
Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: Witch's Vengeance
summary: Make a poppet or image of a victim, bind it to them and abuse it: the victim burns, withers, rots or ages as the image suffers. Ticktock Man is a Data version that ages its target from afar using personal information.
system: Entropy brings decay or disease, Life wrecks the body, and Time with Life ages the target (Feats of Time Magick chart). Without Correspondence at least equal to the damaging Sphere, you must touch the victim.

optional.purpose: curse from a distance with the Life and Time versions
curse from a distance with the Entropy version

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: The Notorious Vampiric Lawn Chair
summary: Turn a vampire into a piece of furniture. Famous, rarely done and a terrible idea: the vampire stays aware, may change back, and its kind will hunt you for it.
system: Beat the vampire's countermagick and do enough to take it to Incapacitated (4+ successes for a young one, more for elders); a lasting change needs Duration on top, e.g. 7 successes for one day. Shapeshifting vampires can buy successes off with blood. Never justifiable as coincidence.

source.section: Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes
Rotes: Mystic Spells and Traditional Rotes

name: Reprogram a HIT Mark X
summary: Rewrite the programming of the newest Technocratic cyborg model, which cannot be hacked by computer skills alone. You need your hands on the unit itself.
system: On top of the Effect, spend 10+ minutes and make the hacking rolls: Intelligence + Hypertech once per model number, difficulty equal to the model (ten rolls at difficulty 10 for a Mark X).

source.section: Appendix I: Hacking a HIT Mark

name: Track Judgment to Its Paradox Realm
summary: Examine the spot where the Paradox spirit Judgment's vehicle vanished with an arrested mage and learn where it went, then follow it if you dare.

optional.purpose: travel to that Realm

name: Tap or Refill a Periapt
summary: Draw stored Quintessence out of a Periapt or Matrix, or channel energy back into it. Without this a mage cannot use such a battery at all.
system: Takes at least one turn of focused concentration. A Periapt holds 5 Quintessence per dot.

name: Shut Down a Cyborg
summary: Disrupt a cyborg's implants so the machinery stops working, often leaving the victim awake inside a dead body.
system: The mage also needs the technical know-how for those implants. Five or more successes take the cyborg offline until repaired.

name: Force Implant Rejection
summary: Make a cyborg's body reject its implants, tearing them loose in a gruesome way.
system: Once past countermagick, the attack does 2 extra health levels of aggravated damage that cannot be soaked. Six or more health levels in one attack rip the implants out.

name: Create a Clam in a Foe's Heart
summary: A player's favorite memory: with no combat skills, a young Verbena used their power over simple life to grow a clam inside an enemy's heart.

name: Channel a Spirit's Essence (Optional Rule)
summary: Optional rule for practices that work through a bond with the spirits, like an Avatar-style bender or a totem shaman: such a mage adds Spirit 2 (Touch Spirit) to the other Spheres of the Effect. Dimensional Science counts as Spirit here, so a Void Engineer qualifies too.
system: Add Spirit 2 on top of the normal Spheres: decay spirits behind an Entropy Effect, Chronos behind a Time Effect, Wolf behind grown fangs (Life 3 / Spirit 2). Rotes written for a spirit-based practice need it as well, so a purely materialist mage cannot use them. Actually channeling entities, calling one up or opening gates needs whatever Spirit rank that feat demands.

combos.note: added to the Effect's other Spheres

source.section: Moments of Magick: A Bit of Spirit?

name: Call Up an Embodiment of a Totem Spirit
summary: Go beyond drawing on the essence of Wolf and summon an actual embodiment of that totem to appear.
system: Spirit 3 or better; bigger entities need more.

source.section: Moments of Magick: A Bit of Spirit?

name: Partial Transformation: Claws, Fangs and Animal Parts
summary: Change only part of a body: jaguar claws on human hands, wolf fangs in a human mouth, goat legs under a human torso. It can be done on purpose or happen when a full change goes halfway.
system: Either use the minor-alteration rank (Life 3 on yourself, Life 4 on another complex creature), or the rank of the full change with half its successes: 1 success for claws on yourself, 2 on someone else. Add Prime 2 for fangs or claws that deal aggravated damage.

combos.note: on yourself, through an animal spirit (optional Bit of Spirit rule)

optional.purpose: the fangs or claws inflict aggravated damage

source.section: Moments of Magick: A Bit of Spirit?
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Partial Transformations

name: Conjure Basic Material from Nothing
summary: Make plain stuff appear out of raw energy, such as a rock in your empty hand.
system: Pair the Sphere that governs the thing with Prime 2: a rock is Matter 3 / Prime 2. Conjured things fade back to nothing when the duration runs out, unless enough successes make them permanent or a Time 4 trigger sets terms for the reversal. See Elemental Mastery for elements and objects in detail.

combos.note: simple material such as a rock

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: The Basics

name: Shapechange Yourself
summary: Change your own body: small shifts of looks and ability, a whole new shape such as a fox or a tiger, or, as a Master, any form at all without ever losing who you are.
system: 2 successes for a similar shape (woman to man), 3 for a very different one (woman to mist); 4 to 6 make it permanent, though you can still undo it at will. The new body brings its natural features (wings, gills, claws) and nothing more, and costs +1 to +3 difficulty for hours to days while you adapt. Below Life 5, every day in a radically different form costs 1 Willpower (1 per 3 days as a similar person), unless you buy the form for 2 experience points. Bygones, six arms and other bizarre shapes are vulgar with witnesses.

combos.note: minor changes of appearance and ability
perfect metamorphosis, keeping your own identity in any form

optional.purpose: a time-trigger that sets when or how the change reverts

coincidentalIf: At the Storyteller's option, the change passes as a costume at a convention, festival or rite where elaborate costumes are normal, and you do nothing a costume could not explain (no growing to dragon size, no flying).

name: Shapechange Another Creature
summary: Turn some other living thing into a different living shape: a bug into a flower, a cat into a tree, a man into a pig, a tiger into a woman. The subject keeps its own mind and nature for a while, and strong Resonance shows through the new form.
system: 4 successes for a similar shape, 5 or more for a radically different one; each extra target adds 1 success (5 for one tiger into a mouse, 7 for three), or divide successes. 8 to 10 successes make it permanent. Turning a creature into something another Sphere governs, like water, adds that Sphere. Subjects tend to lose themselves in the new identity, even under Life 5. Night-Folk still need Life 4 or 5 to reshape, not just the rank that would harm them.

combos.note: minor changes to a complex creature
full transformation of a complex creature

optional.purpose: a time-trigger that sets when or how the change reverts

Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Permanent Changes

name: Build Special Powers into a New Form
summary: Give a shapechanged or newly made creature a power its shape would not have by nature: fire breath, venom, invisibility, floating without wings. The power has to be woven into the transformation itself.
system: Usually Forces and Prime; fire breath is Forces 3 / Prime 2. Each new power adds at least 1 success to the transformation, 2 or more for very strong ones like an aura of crackling electricity. Every use burns 1 Quintessence (one per blast of fire or venomous bite), from your own pool or the creature's life-force; Periapts help. A fire-breathing tiger-woman who also teleports at inhuman speed would need high ranks of Correspondence, Life, Forces, Prime and Time, 7 or 8 successes, and is blatantly vulgar.

combos.note: fire breath and similar energy powers, on top of the shapechange

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: The Basics
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Additional Abilities
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Additional Abilities

name: Create a Higher Organism
summary: Build a complex creature such as a cat, a dog or a person from nothing: a body, a mind, the energy to animate them, and a soul if you want one.
system: Needs at least Life 5 (body), Mind 5 (mind) and Prime 2 (animating energy), plus Spirit 5 for a soul. Unusual powers need extra Spheres on top. The new being knows nothing yet: without long training it may take +3 difficulty on all but the simplest acts.

optional.purpose: give the creature a soul

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: The Basics
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Creating Living Things

name: Shapechange into a Fire-Breathing Tiger
summary: Turn yourself into a tiger that can breathe fire: the book's worked example of a shapechange with a built-in power.
system: At least 4 successes: 3 for the tiger shape and 1 for the fire. Each blast of flame costs 1 Quintessence.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Additional Abilities

name: Shapeshift Clothes and Gear with Matter
summary: Life only reshapes living things, so to have your clothes, weapons or gadgets change along with your body, work Matter into the shapechange.
system: The Matter rank depends on the object: Matter 2 for something simple like a rock, Matter 4 for something intricate like a laptop, plus Forces 3 / Prime 2 if it should still work as a laptop afterward. A bag full of things takes more successes than a single item. Bound items stay tied to you and can later be used against you as personal objects (-3 difficulty).

combos.note: complex objects such as a laptop

optional.purpose: a complex device still functions after the change

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Shapeshifting and Consecrating Possessions
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Shapeshifting and Consecrating Possessions

name: Consecrate Gear for Shapechanging
summary: Bind your clothes and belongings to your own Pattern with Prime so they change when you do, and later cut that bond so nobody can use them against you.
system: Usually 1 extra success per item; a full backpack needs more than a pair of pants. The bond lasts for the Effect's duration and must then be renewed. Until another Prime 1 Effect deconsecrates it, the item counts as a personal object: -3 difficulty to spells cast at you through it (about -1 for things you merely carried). Periapts are always bound to you. Stripping off gear before a change instead takes a turn or more.

combos.note: consecrate an item, or deconsecrate it afterward

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Shapeshifting and Consecrating Possessions
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Shapeshifting and Consecrating Possessions

name: Lock a Werecreature's Form
summary: Force a werecreature to stay in the shape it has now for the duration, or push it into another of its own forms. Shapeshifters tend to take this very badly.
system: Spirit 3 with Life 4 or higher. Other shapechangers usually just shift back at will, and vampires who change through Protean or Vicissitude will soon break free with their own powers.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Shapechanging Shapechangers

name: Split into Several Creatures
summary: Become several separate living creatures at once, each sharing your mind and spirit. As long as one of them survives, so do you.
system: One creature per success over the base. Each has your health levels and Abilities; their wounds all come back to you when they merge, so heal first. Any survivor can turn back into you, and the others vanish when it does. See Everywhere at Once in Mystic Travel.

combos.note: a Master of Life, without the other Spheres

optional.purpose: with Life 5 alone, split your awareness between the bodies without trouble

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Multiple Forms

name: Raise or Lower Attributes with Life
summary: Reshape a body to boost or weaken its Attributes: bigger muscles, finer features, faster reflexes, keener senses for Perception, or a reworked brain for Intelligence or Wits.
system: One dot up or down per success, for the Effect's duration. To keep raised Attributes for good, pay half the usual experience; until you do, the body rejects them for 1 lethal health level a day, no soak. Inhuman mods such as claws, wings or cybernetics stay only as permanent Paradox dots bought as the Enhancements Background. Radical permanent changes may bring Genetic Flaws.
coincidentalIf: The Attributes stay in the human range of 1 to 5 dots and the subject's looks do not change suddenly or radically.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Altering Characteristics
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Permanent Modifications

name: Restore Someone's Original Form
summary: Undo another mage's shapechange, even a permanent one, and put the subject back into its true shape.
system: Either unweave it with Life countermagick that beats the original successes, or cast a new shapechange back to the original form. The mage who made a permanent change can always undo it themselves.

combos.note: reverse a change that took Life 4
reverse a change that took Life 5

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Permanent Changes

name: Change Sex or Gender
summary: Change a body's sex with Life and, if wanted, the inner sense of gender with Mind, for yourself or, with more skill, for someone else.
system: Counts as a similar shape: 2 successes on yourself, 4 on someone else. Long immersion as the other sex costs 1 Willpower every 3 days unless the form is bought for 2 experience points.

optional.purpose: change the psychological sense of gender as well

coincidentalIf: The change is subtle, like becoming your own look-alike twin brother or shifting body language with a few cosmetic touches; an obvious total change is vulgar.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Sex, Gender, and Shapechanging

name: Create Simple Organisms from Energy
summary: Make plants, crabs, ants and similar simple life out of raw energy. Their social life is mostly chemistry, so a new ant fits into its colony as long as the basics are right.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Creating Living Things

name: Bind a Spirit into a Mindless Body
summary: Skip making a mind: grow an empty body and seat a spirit inside it. The result is little more than that entity's puppet, which can bring its own trouble.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Creating Living Things

name: Rapid Cloning
summary: Grow a copy of an organism from a sample of it far faster than any lab could.
system: Life 5 / Mind 5 / Prime 2, often with Time 3 to run the clock faster. The clone still needs teaching and training before it does more than stand around. Sleeper labs can clone simple animals the slow way without magick.

optional.purpose: speed up the clone's growth

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Creating Living Things

name: Conjure Simple Beasts to Fight or Labor
summary: Call instant creatures into being to fight your battles or do simple work. They are good for little else.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Creating Living Things

name: Speed-Teach a New Creature
summary: Imprint skills and knowledge straight into a freshly made creature's mind so it can function sooner.
system: Mind 4 or 5, and many successes for anything close to real intelligence, since even a pet knows a staggering amount. Untaught creations may suffer +3 difficulty on all but the simplest tasks. Time 3 speeds the learning up, but that is vulgar.

optional.purpose: speed up the learning (vulgar)

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Creating Living Things

name: Copy a Mind into a Clone
summary: Transfer or duplicate an existing consciousness, your own included, into a blank clone body, or send your own mind into a duplicate of yourself.
system: The clone has the Abilities the original had at the moment of imprinting and nothing learned later, unless the original mind itself moves over. Muscle memory lags behind, so physical skills need an adjustment period. Bruises and changes on one body do not show on the others.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Creating Living Things
Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Duplicating Yourself

name: Impersonate Someone with Life Magick
summary: Copy another person's looks, on yourself or on a clone or ally, to pass as that individual. Looking right is easy; acting right for long is not.
system: Roll Intelligence or Wits + Subterfuge, difficulty 5 or 6 for simple deceptions and higher for hard ones. Add +1 for small talk and everyday contact, +2 with coworkers and casual friends, +3 with family, close friends and lovers, until the impostor has had time to adjust. Failure is a small slip; a botch threatens to expose the whole act.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Impersonating Other Beings

name: Control Several Duplicate Bodies
summary: Run several cloned copies of yourself at the same time from one mind.
system: Usually 1 success per extra self. Injuries and changes to one body do not carry over to the others, which can raise awkward questions. See Everywhere at Once in Mystic Travel.

source.section: Conjuration, Transformation, Shapechanging, and Modification: Duplicating Yourself

name: Manipulate an Existing Element
summary: Push around an element that is already there: fan a breeze, make a flame flare or gutter, warp metal, turn a lock's tumblers, make a door stick, still a pool. Rank 2 covers small tweaks, rank 3 big ones (flipping a speeding truck), rank 5 disasters such as tornados, whirlpools and earthquakes.
system: Use the Sphere that rules the element: rank 2 basic handling, 3 major shifts, 4 drastic change, 5 full mastery (a breeze is Forces 2, a hurricane Forces 5; earthquakes and hurricanes may need Forces 5 and Matter 5 together). Simple feats take 1-3 successes, big ones 5, 10 or more; a trivial trick like snuffing a candle at home can be an automatic success. It covers one person or about a 10 foot (3 m) area for the normal Duration and stays where it was cast.

combos.note: small feats with energies (fire, wind, heat, light)
small feats with substances (earth, water, metal, dead wood)
large feats, like flipping a truck

coincidentalIf: the element is already present and the change looks like an accident to the unAwakened: a slipped grip, a stumble, a shot that somehow misses.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Transmute One Substance into Another
summary: Change one material into a different one. Simple swaps like rock into steel or water into honey are easy; turning water into pill tablets is a radical change that also wants the right chemistry know-how.

combos.note: simple swaps: rock to steel, water to honey
radical changes: water to Prozac tablets

name: Build a Working Car from Rocks
summary: Shape raw material into a complex machine such as a car. A thing that runs on several elements together needs every Sphere that rules them.

optional.purpose: make the machine actually run

name: Sense Elemental Energies and Substances
summary: Feel how heat, light, wind and other energies flow around you, or pick out the makeup and details of solid stuff such as stone, metal or water.

name: Conjure an Element from Nothing
summary: Call an element into being where there was none: fire in your palm, a gust of wind, water, stone, or living wood.
system: The ruling Sphere at rank 3 or more plus Prime 2. Even air needs Prime 2 to appear in a vacuum. Bigger, purer or more complex results need more successes, per the Magickal Feats chart.

combos.note: solid or liquid materials, or air in a vacuum

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Elemental Assault and Defense
Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Turn Glass into Fire
summary: Change a solid material into a form of energy, such as making a pane of glass burst into flame. Each Sphere involved must be high enough for its half of the job; Forces 2 with Matter 1 will not do it.

name: Set a Self-Sustaining Elemental Effect in an Object
summary: Anchor an elemental Effect inside a material thing so it keeps going on its own, for example a steel car that burns without heating up or taking harm.
system: Add Matter 3 or more to whatever the elemental Effect itself needs.

combos.note: plus the Spheres of the elemental Effect

name: Turn an Element into Ephemera
summary: Change a physical element into spirit-stuff, or spirit-stuff into a physical element.
system: Add Spirit 3 or more to the Pattern Sphere of the element; higher Spirit ranks do more.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism

name: Summon an Elemental
summary: Call a spirit into a big mass of its own element so it takes form there: an earth elemental out of earth, a plant spirit out of plants. Once it stands up it does as it likes and wrecks its surroundings in its own way.
system: You need a large amount of the element at hand, and the bigger the elemental the more of it. You could gate one in from elsewhere with Spirit or Correspondence instead. Full summoning rules are on HDYDT pp. 90-106.

name: Change Chemistry Inside a Living Body
summary: Alter the chemicals inside a working organism, such as turning sugar into cocaine after someone has eaten it. Matter alone cannot reach into a living Pattern.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Psychic Elementalism
summary: Command elements by sheer mental focus, adding a mind link to the usual Pattern magick.
system: Add Mind 3 to the Pattern Spheres the Effect already needs. Spend a temporary Willpower point for one automatic success (one per turn; several over turns for an extended ritual).

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism

name: Lift Objects with Forces
summary: Tweak the physics around something so it rises off the ground. How much you can lift depends on your Forces rank.
system: Forces 1 lifts nothing. Forces 2: one person, about 300 lbs. Forces 3: about two tons, a car. Forces 4: small buildings. Forces 5: anything short of a mountain.

combos.note: nearly anything short of a mountain

name: Quirk of Physics Trap
summary: Bend local physics in a spot: no friction on one stair, odd gravity at a doorway, a cold or hot patch, warped sound, dead phone signal, wiped video. Anyone who blunders in trips, slips or falls.
system: A victim's roll (such as Dexterity + Athletics to stay upright) loses one success per success you rolled. A fall from it deals one bashing health level per success, doubled or tripled for big falls like a staircase. It covers a person or about a 10 foot area and stays put unless locked into a Pattern.

name: Bend a Strike On or Off Target
summary: Nudge the physics of an attack: blur the target, push a weapon aside, or curve a blow into its mark.
system: Your Arete successes raise or lower the difficulty of the attack, as in Magick Enhances Violence (M20 p. 414). The changed difficulty can change the damage too.

name: Harder or Softer Blows
summary: Boost or blunt the kinetic punch of a single hit.
system: Add or remove one success of impact damage. A boosted bashing blow turns lethal; a softened lethal blow turns bashing. Aggravated attacks are not affected this way.

name: Defuse an Elemental Attack
summary: Strip an incoming elemental attack of its power: pull the heat out of a flame or send an electric jolt somewhere else, so it does no harm to what you protect. The energy still has to go somewhere.
system: Match every attacker success with one of yours; with no attacker (a wildfire, say), the size of the force sets the successes. Without a way to change the energy it spills into the surroundings.

optional.purpose: turn the caught energy into another kind of energy
turn the caught energy into Quintessence, one point per health level

name: Change an Attack's Element
summary: Turn one kind of elemental energy into another in mid-attack, such as fire into wind. Forces 2 cannot do this.

name: Lock a Quirk of Physics into a Pattern
summary: Tie a bent-physics field to a person or thing so it travels with them: a jacket that deflects blows, a heavy chest that weighs nothing, brass knuckles that hit harder. It lasts only the normal Duration and the field acts on everything, not just foes.

name: Blackout!
summary: Kill the power to an electrical system. A room or building is easy; a city grid needs great power to beat all its backups.
system: A small area takes a few successes with Forces 2; a whole city needs Forces 5 and many successes. The outage holds until someone repairs it or a backup kicks in, from seconds to days.

optional.purpose: reach the heart of a system far away (Data works too)
wreck vital machinery

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Concoct Chemical Compounds
summary: Turn one chemical into another: salt into cyanide, water into acid, oregano into pot. You must know the chemistry involved.
system: Small simple amounts take Matter 2 or 3; seriously complex work Matter 4 or 5. Usually 1-3 successes. Needs at least three dots in a fitting Ability and specialty (Science: Chemistry, Esoterica: Alchemy and the like).

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Cram a Material's Properties
summary: Study a sample of an unknown material with magickal senses until you understand it well enough to work with it for a day or two.
system: A minute of study for simple materials, up to an hour for complex ones. Afterwards you count as having the needed three dots for that one material, briefly.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Purify Food and Water
summary: Make fouled food or water safe again: strip out mineral poisons, kill germs, or bring food back from the first stages of rot.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Conjure Food and Water
summary: Make edible food or drinkable water appear out of thin air. It will taste awful unless you know how to cook.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Scrounge Edible Leftovers
summary: A street-mage trick: dig through the dumpsters and magickally turn up fast food or leftovers that are safe enough to eat.
system: Cast alongside an Urban Survival roll for the dumpster dive.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Stave Off Hunger and Thirst
summary: Hold back the effects of going without food and water for a while.
system: Each success buys one extra day without water and one extra week without food. One roll only; when the successes run out, starvation sets in.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Create Light
summary: Brighten what little light is around, or flood a pitch-dark place with sudden strong light. It is not true sunlight and does not hurt vampires.

combos.note: boost light that is already there
total darkness, or strong sudden light

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Gate In Real Sunlight
summary: Open a gate from a sunlit place to a dark one so genuine sunlight pours through. If a broken window would do, just break the window.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Searing Light Blast
summary: Fire off blasts of intense light that cause lethal damage. With more magick the light burns vampires as if it were sunlight.

optional.purpose: aggravated damage to vampires

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Reproduce True Sunlight
summary: Recreate sunlight in every physical respect, which the Storyteller may let count as real sunlight against the undead. A spiritual mage can add the holy essence of the sun as well.
system: Storyteller's option, depending on whether sunlight is pure physics or divine grace in your chronicle.

optional.purpose: channel the spiritual essence of sunlight too

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics
Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Deflect Missiles
summary: Push an incoming bullet, arrow or energy beam off course. Works one shot at a time, not as a standing field.
system: Each of your successes cancels one attacker success, like a dodge. Beat the attack and the shot goes elsewhere, maybe into a bystander; double the attacker's successes and it rebounds on the shooter for its base damage. Stopping every bullet in midair is possible but blatantly vulgar.
coincidentalIf: it is played as a dodge-like deflection rather than bullets hanging in the air.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Bioelectric Assault
summary: Scramble a body's electrical impulses to stop organs, clot blood, lock muscles or damage the brain. You need to understand how bodies work.
system: Aggravated damage: the normal amount plus one success for Forces. Unlike a plain Life 3 attack, nobody can see the inside misfire.
coincidentalIf: the victim simply seems to suffer a sudden medical failure; a trail of such deaths draws suspicion.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Trigger an Involuntary Reflex
summary: Use a small electrical or chemical nudge to make a target vomit, spasm, go briefly blind or reel in confusion instead of taking damage.
system: For one or two turns the target is as helpless as under brief Mind 4 puppetry, yet Willpower gives no defense because the body, not the mind, is hit.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics
Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Chemical Body Disruption
summary: Throw off someone's body chemistry: make them drunk or sick, or impair their senses and thinking.
system: Bashing or lethal damage, depending on what you do to them.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Bend Light or Sound Around Yourself
summary: Curve light around your body to vanish from sight, or do the same with sound to move in silence.
system: Observers spot you with Perception + Alertness or Awareness; each of your successes adds +1 difficulty, up to +3. Bigger areas need higher Forces.

optional.purpose: still sense your way around while light or sound is bent away

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Cloak a Vehicle
summary: Make something large, like a helicopter, invisible and silent, with the cloak locked onto the vehicle so it moves with it.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Shadowplay
summary: Drive light away and make the shadows move, or shape light and dark into figures of people, beasts or horrors that distract or frighten. The same works on sound. You need some light to start with.
system: Forces 2 covers about 10 feet; the top ranks reach a mile or more. Shaping figures takes a Manipulation + Expression roll.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Shoot Around Corners
summary: Fire at one spot and have the bullet come out somewhere else, or bend its path around cover. Projectiles only; beams fly straight.
system: +3 to the Dexterity + Firearms difficulty. Good for one shot or burst; cast again for each one.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Synthesize New Materials
summary: Turn raw stuff into something else entirely, such as sand into a rough wooden table, pasta into armor or sand into chips. Fine work needs real craft skills, and the result reverts when the Effect ends unless made permanent.
system: Matter 2 alone makes simple things; complex or brand-new materials need higher ranks plus Forces, Life or Spirit for any parts they rule. Things that radiate or explode need both Matter and Forces. Blatantly impossible transmutations like light into steel are vulgar.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics
Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Shift the Temperature
summary: Warm or chill an area, from mildly uncomfortable up to flash-freezing flesh or melting metal into slag.
system: Forces 2 stays within comfort and discomfort. Forces 3 makes damaging extremes, usually bashing, but heated metal or boiling water can deal lethal and molten metal aggravated. Freezing things solid (lethal or aggravated, worse if shattered) or melting metal takes Forces 4 or 5.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Classic Tricks of Mystic Physics

name: Spiritual Elemental Bond
summary: Join your soul to the spirit of one element, as the benders of Avatar do, and work it through that bond. You live and dress in its Resonance and focus on that single element.
system: Add Spirit 2 or more to the usual Pattern Spheres. Spend a temporary Willpower point for one automatic success. Dimensional Science cannot do this.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism

name: Psychic Telekinesis
summary: Move or levitate things with your mind alone, as long as you keep concentrating.
system: Higher Forces moves more, per the Forces and Weight chart (2: 300 lbs, 3: two tons, 4: small buildings, 5: almost anything). Roll Willpower as well as Arete; the Storyteller may ask a Willpower point for very big loads. Usually vulgar unless small or passed off as plausible tech.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism
Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism

name: Pyrokinesis
summary: Steer, kindle or grow fire with your mind, even setting alight things that should not burn.
system: Needs concentration and a Willpower roll; the Storyteller may ask a Willpower point for large or hard fires such as burning metal.

combos.note: start fire from nothing or make a fire much bigger

optional.purpose: burn flame-resistant materials
set living beings alight
burn Umbral ephemera

coincidentalIf: only small nudges to existing flames that can pass as chance.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism

name: Psychomanifestation
summary: Shape or create solid and liquid elements, such as a block of stone, by force of mind. It works like Pyrokinesis with Matter in place of Forces.
system: Willpower roll as for Pyrokinesis; the Storyteller should ask a Willpower point for making solids from thin air. Plain Matter with Prime is simpler for conjuring.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism
Elemental Mastery: Psychic and Spiritual Elementalism

name: Hurl an Elemental Blast
summary: Throw a fireball, a lightning bolt, a gust of wind or a hail of stone. The blast appears, does its damage and is gone; another needs another casting.
system: Forces adds one success to damage. Blunt force deals bashing, sharp lethal, and hot things (fire, electricity, steam, molten stuff) lethal or aggravated. A targeted blast must hit as an attack; area blasts count as Environmental Hazards.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Elemental Assault and Defense

name: Raise an Elemental Wall
summary: Build a lasting elemental barrier or weapon: a hedge of thorns, a metal wall, a flood, a plasma force-field. It lasts until its Duration ends, someone dispels or breaks it, or its fuel runs out.
system: Add the successes for the Duration and the Damage you want from the Base Damage or Duration chart. A one-day ice wall dealing six levels needs 6 successes; as plasma it needs 5, since Forces adds one damage success. Fire and similar energies burn fuel unless fed Quintessence.

optional.purpose: keep an energy wall burning on Quintessence instead of fuel

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Elemental Assault and Defense
Elemental Mastery: Elemental Assault and Defense

name: Fuel an Element with Quintessence
summary: Feed a fire, bolt or laser with raw Quintessence so it keeps going without coal, gas or batteries.
system: Costs 1 to 5 Quintessence per turn, by how intense the energy is (Storyteller's call). Without it, an energy Effect lasts only as long as its mundane fuel.

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Elemental Assault and Defense

name: Steer Existing Weather
summary: Work with the weather that is already forming and push it where you want: a gentle probability nudge, a strong suggestion, or yanking the elements into line. The weather still follows the local climate; snow on a cold November night, never on a hot July day.
system: Weather magick takes at least 5 successes: small changes about 5, big ones 10 or more, near-impossible ones 20 or more. Changes take hours; doing it in minutes is vulgar. The probability nudge goes its own way and works slowly. Fitting Abilities (Meteorology, Weathercraft) can lower the difficulty.

combos.note: nudge the odds of a pattern forming
a strong push: the front forms fast and as you design

optional.purpose: work it somewhere far away (Correspondence must equal your Forces rank)

name: Storm-Cocoon
summary: Wrap yourself and your friends in a shield against the storm you are raising: Forces fends off the elements, Entropy steers away falling roofs and flying junk, Prime keeps it fueled while you work.
system: Five successes guard a circle about 10 feet across for the length of the storm; each extra success adds another 10 feet.
coincidentalIf: it does not show as an obvious bubble such as a glowing field; a hypertech shield may stay coincidental even then.

name: Summon a Storm
summary: Call up a major tempest: gather existing weather into a storm, whip up blizzards, floods and thunderstorms, or at the top end produce impossible weather such as summer blizzards and tornados from a clear sky. Without a cocoon you suffer it like everyone else.
system: A storm out of calm skies, or where storms cannot form, costs one Quintessence per dot of every Sphere used (Forces 5 alone: 5; the full combo: 15). Roll Willpower as it gathers and again each hour or scene (difficulty 5 rain, 7 thunderstorm, 9 tornado); a failure lets it run wild. Ending it takes a new ritual with at least 5 more successes than raised it. The dangerous storms create Environmental Hazards; you can add separate elemental attacks.

combos.note: pull existing weather into a storm
impossible weather, hazards for miles; vulgar

optional.purpose: raise the storm somewhere far away

source.section: Elemental Mastery: Raining on Someone Else's Parade

name: Shake the Earth
summary: Make the ground, or a house or skyscraper, tremble and break. The quake damages structures, trees and terrain rather than people, though collapses and sinkholes can hurt anyone nearby.
system: Normal damage plus one success for Forces, applied to structures. Roughly 100 feet of diameter per success, adjusted by the Storyteller for the ground and what stands on it.

name: Create a Horizon Realm
summary: Build a whole new world in the Horizon, with its own land, climate, living things and flow of time. Usually a group of mages working for months or years.
system: Needs a Node of at least five dots first. Shaping a livable Realm can take 100+ successes over several Great Work rituals. Higher Entropy, Mind and Time add stronger quirks of chance, vision or time. May fail outright, or turn lethal, while the Avatar Storm rages.

name: See Quintessence Flows and Hold More Than Your Avatar
summary: The entry-level energy trick: notice where Quintessence is flowing, read the energy signature it carries, and pack your own Pattern with more Quintessence than your Avatar rating normally allows.
system: Quintessence work stays coincidental while less than 10 points move in a turn and nothing visibly withers or glows; 10 or more points in one turn makes a light show that is usually vulgar.

name: Pour Quintessence into a Pattern
summary: Push Quintessence into something that already exists to strengthen or energize it, or into empty space to start building something out of nothing (with the Sphere of whatever you make).

name: Channel Quintessence Beyond Your Avatar Rating
summary: Use more Quintessence in a turn than your Avatar rating, and draw it from outside sources such as Nodes, Tass and living things instead of only your own store.
system: Below Prime 3 a mage can spend at most their Avatar rating in Quintessence per turn. With Prime 3 an Effect can move up to 2 Quintessence per success (3 successes: 6 points, 5 successes: 10). Channeling takes touch, concentration or meditation; Primal Utility users do it as an act of investment.

name: Tap a Wellspring of Emotion
summary: Soak up the free Quintessence that strong emotions release at an exciting event (a concert, a riot, a revival) and use it to power yourself. Many mages stir up the event themselves to get the energy they want.
system: The Wellspring's Resonance has to suit both you and your purpose: a calm mage gets little from a battle unless they want a fight. Primal Utility 4 does the same with Ventures and opportunities.

name: Open a New Node or Conflux
summary: Gather the loose currents of energy in an area and knot them into a lasting Node. Technocrats with Primal Utility make a Conflux instead, usually by founding a business, staging a concert or exploiting a resource.
system: Roughly 10 successes per dot of the Node Background created, as a ritual; the Storyteller sets the exact number, and a place thick with Resonance is easier than a dead one.
coincidentalIf: the energy flow stays below 10 Quintessence per turn

name: Create Tass or Currency
summary: Draw free Quintessence to yourself and set it into a physical form through your focus: prayed into holy water, or counted into banknotes by a Syndicate agent. The object is used up as its energy is spent.
system: When the last of the Quintessence is drawn out, the Tass is gone: the water evaporates, the bills crumble.

source.section: Energy-Work: Creating and Using Tass/ Currency

name: Charge or Drain a Periapt or Matrix
summary: Move Quintessence into or out of a Periapt (a Matrix, for Technocrats): a lasting battery prepared to store energy that, unlike Tass, does not fall apart when emptied.
system: Each success shifts up to 2 Quintessence into or out of the battery. With Prime 4 you can recharge a Periapt wherever you are, at any time.

name: Draw on Tass or a Periapt You Are Not Carrying
summary: Tap the Quintessence in Tass or a Periapt that is not on your body. Carried batteries need no Effect at all: you can use your Avatar rating's worth per turn reflexively.

combos.note: within reach but not touching you

source.section: Energy-Work: Accessing Tass or Periapt Quintessence

name: Conjure Material Forms from Quintessence
summary: Fill empty space with focused energy and build a new force, substance or creature out of it. Prime supplies the raw stuff; the Pattern Sphere gives it shape.
system: Conjured things last for the Effect's Duration unless you dismiss them earlier.
coincidentalIf: it is well hidden, or done through a technological instrument such as a laser weapon

name: Mask or Recolor Your Aura
summary: Dim, brighten or change the color and texture of your own aura, either to hide what you are or to show an observer a false picture.
system: Each success takes one success off anyone trying to read your aura, now or later. A Charisma + Subterfuge roll can lower the difficulty, to a minimum of 3.

name: Give Mental Phantasms Visible Form
summary: Spin thoughts into half-real shapes that other people can see: illusions, mental projections, shared dreamscapes.
coincidentalIf: a technological device such as a TV screen or holographic projector carries the image

source.section: Energy-Work: Conjuring Immaterial Mind and Spirit Forms

name: Give a Spirit a Solid Body
summary: Charge a spirit with so much Quintessence that it becomes solid in the physical world. When the body is destroyed the spirit simply goes back to being ephemeral.
system: The body has 2 health levels per success. The book's rule starts counting after the first success, but its own example gives 6 health levels for 3 successes.

source.section: Energy-Work: Conjuring Immaterial Mind and Spirit Forms
Energy-Work: Conjuring Immaterial Mind and Spirit Forms

name: Energize an Item to Deal or Soak Aggravated Damage
summary: Make an object more real so that it can dish out or withstand aggravated damage: holy weapons that wound spirits, vampires and werewolves, or sacred armor against their attacks.
system: Lasts for the Effect's Duration unless the item is enchanted permanently.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Objects and Elements

name: Craft Wonders (by Prime Rank)
summary: What you can enchant depends on your Prime: small trinkets first, then lasting energy stores and temporary Talismans, then permanent Talismans.
system: Crafting rules are in M20 pp. 652-653; Charms and Artifacts are covered in The Book of Secrets.

name: Quintessence Blade or Bolt
summary: Form a weapon or a blast of pure metaphysical energy, such as a sword of light or a plasma hammer. It burns on contact but is cold, so it sets nothing alight.
system: Aggravated damage. In HDYDT it costs 1 Quintessence per turn of use, hit or miss, so it suits ambushes and last stands; the M20 chart (p. 510) charges 1 Quintessence per health level of damage instead.

optional.purpose: give the energy real heat

coincidentalIf: it is built into technology, or used among believers in a place where miracles are accepted

name: Reverse Magnetic Polarity
summary: Change the magnetic polarity of an object by adjusting the Quintessence that flows through it.
coincidentalIf: nothing reveals the altered property

name: Stop a Chemical from Bonding
summary: Take away a chemical's ability to bond with other substances, which changes or cancels what it normally does (a poison that cannot react, a fuel that will not combine).
coincidentalIf: nothing reveals the altered property

name: Make a Solid Object Insubstantial
summary: Adjust an object's energy flow so that a solid thing loses its substance and other things pass through it.
coincidentalIf: nothing reveals the altered property

name: Heatless Fire and Shockless Electricity
summary: Strip an energy of one of its usual properties: fire that gives off no heat and does not use up its fuel, or electricity that no longer shocks.
system: Large or obvious changes are vulgar; a hand held unharmed in the flame gives the game away.
coincidentalIf: nothing reveals the altered property

name: Energize a Creature to Deal or Soak Aggravated Damage
summary: Charge an organic creature with Quintessence so that its attacks deal aggravated damage and it can soak aggravated wounds.

name: Make a Living Charm
summary: Store one single-use magickal Effect inside a living creature. It goes off when the Duration ends or when you choose to trigger it, and afterwards the creature is ordinary again.
system: Costs 1 Quintessence per dot of the highest Sphere in the stored Effect. The Life rank needed is lower than for real Pattern changes because the creature only carries the energy for a moment.

optional.purpose: set a trigger that outlasts the normal Duration

name: Living Charm: Tree That Burns Unharmed
summary: Enchant a tree so that it bursts into flames on cue without being burned itself.
system: Costs 4 Quintessence (1 per dot of the highest Sphere).

name: Living Charm: Blossoms of Ice
summary: Enchant a plant so that, when the charm goes off, it flowers into ice.
system: Costs 4 Quintessence (1 per dot of the highest Sphere).

name: Living Charm: Carrier of Luck
summary: Load a person, even a child, with an Effect that spreads good or bad luck to those around them.
system: Costs 4 Quintessence (1 per dot of the highest Sphere).

name: Living Bomb
summary: Turn a living being into a walking explosive set to go off at a chosen moment. A cruel weapon that the book treats as an atrocity.
system: Costs 4 Quintessence (1 per dot of the highest Sphere).

name: Fuse Flesh and Machine with Quintessence
summary: Use Quintessence to join living tissue and inert matter into one working whole, installing cybernetics or other upgrades in a complex creature.

name: Bring On and Energize Orgasm
summary: Bring a willing lover to climax by magick, stretch the moment out, and with Prime merge, boost or drain the energy between you. Doing this to an unwilling person is rape, and ethical mages never go there.

optional.purpose: prolong the ecstasy
blend, boost or drain the shared energy

source.section: Energy-Work: What You Thought This Section Said

name: Rubbing the Bones
summary: Make the Quintessence inside a victim surge and waver, causing agony; onlookers see the victim flicker like a ghost. A favorite of mages who cannot yet do real damage.
system: Bashing damage by successes. The victim rolls Willpower against a difficulty equal to the health levels taken before soak; on a failure the pain paralyzes them.

name: Quintessential Blessing
summary: Fill someone so full of life that they glow and feel unstoppable: they ignore wound penalties for the Duration, and a mage's Quintessence pool fills up.
system: Grants 2 Quintessence per success (4 successes: 8 points).

optional.purpose: add story-based good fortune until it wears off

name: Add Temporary Health Levels
summary: Reinforce a Pattern with extra life-force so that it gains health levels that take hits first, leaving only cuts and bruises behind.
system: 2 extra health levels per success, counted like damage, for the Duration or until used up; they absorb bashing, lethal and aggravated damage. Each absorbed level that no normal human could survive (being set on fire, a falling safe) gives 1 Paradox that stays after the Effect ends.

name: Energy Vampirism
summary: Siphon life energy from the people around you. Victims just feel tired and sore unless they have Awareness or can see Prime energy.
system: Taking energy by force or in secret has heavy Resonance consequences (the Lady Macbeth effect).

combos.note: willing or seduced donors, or a forced drain the victim feels
unwilling victims who notice nothing until they collapse

coincidentalIf: the mage does not drain victims to the point of death

name: Disintegrate by Withdrawing Quintessence
summary: Scatter a target's Quintessence back into the world until it simply stops existing. Technocrats call it liquidating an asset; as a sacrifice, the energy is given up rather than kept.
system: Aggravated damage by successes. The target is gone when it runs out of health levels, or for objects Durability and Structure.
coincidentalIf: a believable method such as fire, acid or cremation does the visible work

name: Heart's Blood
summary: Bleed, strain or exhaust yourself to pour your own life-force into a task and make it easier.
system: Each success moves 1 Quintessence from your Pattern into the task, for -1 difficulty per point (the Storyteller may let this pass the usual -3 limit). You have 10 such points on top of your normal Quintessence, one per health level; the last three take you past Incapacitated, and spending them all kills you. This damage heals only with time and rest.

name: Burnt Offerings
summary: Draw Quintessence from an object you give up in a ritual sacrifice: burned, smashed, dissolved, sunk at sea or buried for good. Without a real sacrifice there is no energy.

name: Bond of Blood
summary: Take Quintessence from a willing donor, or give your own to someone, sealed by a gesture of surrender such as a kiss, a blessing or shed blood.
system: Amount by successes on the Base Damage and Duration chart (2 points per success).

name: Lambs to the Slaughter
summary: Rip Quintessence out of an unwilling living sacrifice, usually while killing it. The Resonance of the act clings to whoever takes the energy, with grim consequences.
system: Typical yields: small animal 5 (3-5), wolf, horse or human 10, tiger, elephant or whale 15-25, changeling 20-30, mage 10-30, spirit its Essence, vampire 10 + Blood Pool, werecreature 20 + Gnosis.

name: Perceive Auras
summary: See the halo of life-energy around living and half-living things and read moods, states and natures from its colors and textures (a vampire's is pale, a mage's sparkles).
system: Perception + Awareness roll; the Effect can lower its difficulty. Reading spirits or the undead may add +1 difficulty. Stronger life-force or Resonance gives a brighter aura.

source.section: Common Magickal Effects: Perception and Psychic Powers

name: Read a Resonance Signature
summary: Pick out the Resonance or Synergy signature that clings to a person.
system: Perception + Awareness roll.

name: Spot the Afterglow of Magick
summary: Sense the traces that spells leave behind in a place after they are cast.
system: A small spell fades in about five minutes; big ones linger for hours or days, longer if Paradox struck. The difficulty climbs as traces fade. (Plain sensing of magick in use within about 100 feet is a Perception + Awareness roll, difficulty 6, from 4 for strong Effects to 9 for subtle ones.)

name: Share Your Enhanced Senses
summary: Let someone else experience what your magickal senses pick up. Through touch a willing partner needs nothing extra; the Spheres below reach past touch or force the visions on someone.
system: One extra success per person you share with (one partner: 2 successes). Must be rolled; no automatic success. Forced visions can count as a psychic assault.

combos.note: willing, within a yard or two
unwilling, within a yard or two

coincidentalIf: shared with other mages, or with Sleepers who can explain it away as drugs or expanded consciousness

name: Project What You Perceive
summary: Add this to a perception Effect to show what you are sensing as a picture or sound others can follow: on a screen, in smoke, in a mirror.
system: Lasts for the normal Duration unless you end it early.

optional.purpose: make the projection last past the normal Duration

coincidentalIf: the setting accepts it, such as a hologram on smoke at a rave

source.section: Enhanced Perceptions: Projecting Images and Impressions
Enhanced Perceptions: Projecting Images and Impressions

name: Scry a Distant Place or Subject
summary: Watch, listen to or otherwise sense a far-off place or target, by crystal ball or by webcam. Combine it with another Sphere's senses to perceive that Sphere's things far away.
system: Range and difficulty follow the Correspondence Ranges chart (Data uses the Data Connections chart, M20 p. 524); a tie to the target such as hair or records helps. A distant Effect can never be higher than your Correspondence rank.

combos.note: keep watch on distant living things

source.section: Enhanced Perceptions: Perceiving From a Distance

name: Command a Mind from Afar
summary: Give orders to a distant mind. Because a long-range Effect is capped by your Correspondence, Mind 3 at a distance needs Correspondence 3, not 2.

source.section: Enhanced Perceptions: Perceiving From a Distance

name: Pre- and Postcognition on a Place or Object
summary: Look into the past or likely future of a place or object, now and then of a living thing. You only see what that subject could have witnessed, and the visions tend to be symbolic and unclear.
system: The Time-Sphere Timelines chart sets the successes needed for each span. The Storyteller may roll in secret so the player does not know how reliable the vision is.

name: Martial Strike: Spot the Weak Point
summary: Before you hit, read the target's Pattern for cracks and weak spots, then aim your blow at them.
system: Lowers the difficulty of one mundane attack (Magick Enhancing Abilities), at most -3. The insight usually lasts a single blow; a fixed, solid target like a wall can be hit again at the same difficulty until the damage changes its flaws.

name: Martial Strike: Forces-Driven Blow
summary: Bend the physics of your punch or kick so it lands with far more speed and impact than muscle alone could give it.
system: The blow does lethal instead of bashing damage and gains one automatic damage success from Forces. Combine with Prime 2, Life 3 or Entropy 4 to make that extra damage aggravated too.

name: Martial Strike: Aggravated Damage
summary: Make your unarmed blows deal aggravated damage, whether by charging them with vital energy, shattering the target's living Pattern, or breaking through the flaws in its body.
system: Prime 2 costs 1 Quintessence per strike. Life 3 works on living beings and is vulgar. On their own these only change the damage type; add Forces 2 to also deal extra damage.

optional.purpose: extra damage on top of the aggravated type

name: The Pain-Shrug: Martial Toughness
summary: Harden your body so you can soak lethal and aggravated damage, push your Stamina past its normal limits, and endure extreme weather, hunger, sickness and other hardships.
system: 2 successes to soak lethal, 3 to soak aggravated, plus 1 per dot of raised Stamina up to 5 and 2 per dot above 5 (Stamina 4 raised to 6 while soaking aggravated: 3 + 1 + 2 = 6). Lasts the normal Duration. Healing aggravated damage costs 1 Quintessence per health level; combine with Chi Healing to mend fast. Looks like toughness, but visibly soaking gunfire or swelling with inhuman stamina is vulgar.

name: Calming Glance and Predator's Eye
summary: Stop a fight before it starts by pushing an emotion into a would-be attacker: soothing calm that takes the will to fight away, or fear, panic or blind rage that ruins their tactics and gives you the edge.
system: Difficulty is the target's Willpower for a normal human, Willpower + 3 for a mage or other supernatural. Against a group of mortals use the normal casting difficulty; against a group of supernaturals use the highest Willpower in it (default 5) + 5. One or two successes usually stop a casual opponent. You can use a social roll to cut the Effect's difficulty, or the Effect to cut the social roll's, by up to -3; both get rolled.
coincidentalIf: you do not make the magick blatantly obvious; a hard stare helps

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: Victory in the Mind
summary: Win the fight inside your own head first. With a war-cry, kata, prayer or death glare you either psych out your opponent or psych yourself up.
system: Each success takes -1 off your next roll, at most -3. Psyching out the foe makes that roll a Facedown; psyching up makes it your next initiative, attack or defense roll. Five successes on a psych-out may make the opponent give up without a fight.

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: Psychic Duel in the High Umbra
summary: Both fighters project their astral selves into the High Umbra, into an arena shaped by their imaginations, and fight it out there until one or both are satisfied.
system: Uses the Astral Projection feat; astral combat follows the Astral Travel rules in M20 (pp. 476-478).

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: The War Dance
summary: Lead a brief rite (song, dance, rousing speech) that fills your allies with battle-lust, courage and loyalty. They follow your orders short of suicide or atrocity, maybe even then.
system: Extended roll. Difficulty 7 or the group's highest Willpower, whichever is higher; social rolls and a fired-up crowd can lower it by up to -3. Successes needed: 3 for up to 5 close allies, 5 for 5 like-minded people, 7 for 20 allies or 10 like-minded, 10 for 50 or 20, 13 for 75 or 50, 15 for 100 or 75, 17 for 150 or 100, 20 for a decent mob. Add 1 success per turn it should last.
coincidentalIf: you do not use obvious magick

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: The Ghost-Dance
summary: A mighty war dance that also makes your allies almost immune to harm. Shamans can call friendly spirits into the rite to add their power.
system: Per ally: 3 successes to soak lethal, 5 to soak aggravated, +2 per dot of Stamina raised, and 1 Quintessence each. At most 10 people. Lasts one turn per extra success. Needs a long extended ritual.

optional.purpose: call friendly spirits into the rite

coincidentalIf: performed on your own people who share the belief, and the crowd is not visibly glowing or shrugging off bullets

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck
Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: Battlefield Sense
summary: Sense the whole battleground at once: who stands where, the obstacles, the weapons lying around. A mental link lets your allies share the picture.
system: Arete roll, usually coincidental. Each success lowers the difficulty of a Perception roll to map the field by -1, at most -3. With an Academics (Strategy or Tactics) specialty or Leadership you add that Ability and can direct your allies.

optional.purpose: share the picture with linked allies

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: Remote Command Network
summary: See the fight through an ally's eyes, or with Correspondence run a whole squad: you take in what each of them sees and give them orders.
system: A viewer must be willing or you must beat their Willpower (see Sharing Perceptions). The network costs 1 extra success per ally in it. You only see what your troops see, and many feeds at once are hard to follow.
coincidentalIf: the allies are willing and the link is invisible or runs through tactical displays and comms gear

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: Reading an Opponent
summary: Keep a sensing Effect running during a fight to read it as it happens: where your attackers stand, what they mean to do, or where everyone will be second by second.
system: Needs Wits 2 and 2 dots in Brawl, Do, Melee or Martial Arts. Takes a full action; Arete at difficulty 4 or 5 by rank. Each success gives -1 to one kind of attack or defense roll (one Attribute + Ability pair) for one action. Use one Sphere at a time. Not at range without Correspondence or a scope, and never for Arete rolls.

combos.note: where everyone will be, moment to moment

source.section: Martial Arts: Before a Blow is Struck

name: Martial Strike: Break Inanimate Objects
summary: Hit an object so that your blow tears straight through its material integrity: smash doors, walls, weapons or armor.
system: It does not let you ignore a person's armor, but you can aim at the armor itself to damage it. See Bustin' Stuff in M20.

name: Martial Strike: Hurt Undead, Shapeshifters or Fae
summary: Deal aggravated damage with your blows to beings whose bodies are not plain flesh: walking dead, werecreatures and faerie folk each need an extra Sphere on top of Life.
system: Plain physical blows (or Forces 2) still hurt such beings normally; the extra Sphere is only needed to make Life's aggravated disruption work on them.

combos.note: changelings, True Fae and other faeries

name: Mind-Altering Punch: Stay DOWN!
summary: Pack an emotional jolt into a punch: the target loses heart, flies into a rage, or just stays on the floor.
system: Works like Predator's Eye riding on the blow. The target resists with Willpower (difficulty 6) and must get more successes than your Arete roll.
coincidentalIf: you are not ridiculously showy about it

name: Mind-Altering Punch: Heartbreak Slap
summary: Deliver a Psychic Blast through a slap or blow, so it hurts far more inside than out. With Life added it becomes a brain-shredding Psychic Shatter.
system: The damage comes from the psychic attack, not the physical hit (Violence as a Focus, M20 p. 413). See Psychic Blast and Psychic Shatter in Uncanny Influence.

name: Stunning Nerve-Pinch
summary: A light touch in the right spot, and the opponent is overwhelmed by pain or simply told to drop. You can choose to do no damage and just stun.
system: The target goes limp and obeys unless they win a Willpower roll (difficulty 6) with more successes than you.

name: Knocking Sense Into (or Out of) Someone
summary: A blow or a touch that scrambles the target's mind: madness, hallucinations, lost memories, puppet-like control. It adds nothing to the physical damage.
system: The Uncanny Influence section has the madness, puppetry and false-memory rules. Normally not coincidental, though a clever fighter can make it fit the scene; passing it off as brain damage brings legal trouble.

name: The Delayed-Death Touch
summary: Touch a target so that they die later: after six steps, thirteen heartbeats, an hour, whatever trigger fits your art.
system: Time 4 sets the trigger; Life 3 does the aggravated damage, often built up with an extended killing-blow ritual. Adding chi (Prime 2, 1 Quintessence) does not raise the damage but fits the style.

optional.purpose: chi-based version, 1 Quintessence, no extra damage

name: The Chi-Field Push
summary: Raise a wall of chi that sends people and objects flying without you laying a finger on them.
system: 1 Quintessence per turn. Anyone attacking or pushed by you is thrown unless a Strength or Dexterity roll (difficulty 6) beats your Arete successes. Normal Forces damage, but bashing on landing; a strong roll can still break a neck. Throwing people without touching them is vulgar outside strong martial-arts realities.

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi
Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: Chi Whirlwind of Leaves
summary: Use chi to whip the winds around you into a swirl of leaves and dust that confuses and distracts your opponents.
system: Same Spheres as the Chi-Field Push, but it does no damage.

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: The Chi-Fire Punch
summary: Focus your chi into your punches, strikes and kicks so they deal aggravated damage.
system: 1 Quintessence per blow.
coincidentalIf: you are not glowing, burning or showing some other paranormal sign

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: Chi Flight
summary: Make yourself light as a feather in the wuxia style: run over impossible footing, glide short distances, duel in treetops or skim across water.
system: Forces handles gravity and inertia, Life binds it to your own body, Prime powers it with chi. 1 Quintessence; lasts the normal Duration. Plain Forces 2 could also lift you, but that is not this martial feat.

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: Chi Healing
summary: Redirect chi flow through massage, focus or acupuncture to mend wounds and cure illness in yourself or someone else.
system: 1 Quintessence per attempt for bashing or lethal damage; 1 Quintessence per health level of aggravated damage (Magickal Healing, M20 p. 409). Invisible healing is coincidental; curing cancer or closing gaping wounds with a few needles is vulgar where reality does not accept it.

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: The Spirit-Strike
summary: Channel chi through your living body to punch spirits and ghosts. Stronger versions actually wound them.
system: Spirit 2 lets you touch an ephemeral being long enough for one physical blow; Spirit 3 harms spirits as if with Life magick; Entropy 3 does the same against ghosts only, with Entropy's nasty side effects on them (Spirit Combatants, M20 p. 418).

combos.note: land one blow on a spirit

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: The War-Power Chi Shout
summary: Let out a chi-charged cry that terrifies your enemies, swells your own strength and charges your blows with aggravated force. A variant of the Kiaijutsu Iron Shout.
system: Life raises chosen Traits by one dot per success; Mind terrifies as Predator's Eye; Prime lets you deal aggravated damage for 1 Quintessence per strike. Lasts the normal Duration. The Mind part is coincidental; the Life and Prime parts are vulgar except where people expect wild martial powers.

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi
Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: The Chi-Vampire Strike
summary: Drain the vital energy out of an opponent on contact, taking Quintessence instead of dealing damage. A true master can burn the victim out entirely.
system: The drain leaves the victim weak but unhurt and is coincidental. The annihilation makes the victim explode or disintegrate and is very vulgar. Draining living beings follows Lambs to the Slaughter (Energy-Work, pp. 49-50).

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: Elemental Fury Chi
summary: Pour chi into elemental form: flaming hands, crackling lightning, skin of stone, wood or metal, iron spikes. You both deal and resist aggravated damage.
system: Forces for fire, lightning or air; Matter for wood, metal or stone. Damage depends on the element, which may also set fires or shake the ground (Environmental Hazards). 1 Quintessence per turn, from yourself, a Periapt, Tass or a drained foe. Vulgar except where legendary martial powers are the consensus.

source.section: Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi
Martial Arts: Feats of Focused Chi

name: The Pain-Shrug: Ignore Wound Penalties
summary: Shut out the pain of your injuries through sheer will and keep fighting at full strength. The wounds are still there; they just do not slow you down until your body gives out.
system: Ignore all wound penalties for the Duration, at any injury level short of death.

name: Slipstream
summary: Seem to be a hair's breadth from where you really are, so blows just miss. Pick a method that fits: shifting space, luck, bent light or gravity, or perfect timing.
system: Each success adds +1 to the attacker's difficulty. Spend extra successes on Duration to keep it up for several turns.

combos.note: control the odds of being hit

coincidentalIf: you do not overdo it, so it just looks like great dodging or a bad attacker

name: Elemental Armor
summary: Wrap yourself in your chosen element as armor: burning flesh, buffeting winds, or skin of stone, wood or metal. Most masters only ever learn one element.
system: No new rules: borrow the systems of the Pain-Shrug, Slipstream and Elemental Fury Chi, picking the Spheres that fit the element. Lasts the Effect's Duration. Brawlers and other casual fighters cannot use it. Vulgar outside elemental or wild martial paradigms.

name: The Neo: Stop Projectiles
summary: Raise a kinetic shield in reach of your hands that stops or knocks aside arrows, bullets and thrown bottles, shown as bracers, spinning staves, flying sleeves or pure reflexes. It can also deflect energy blasts.
system: 1 success stops an arrow, 2 a gunshot, 3 a hail of arrows or bullets, 5 anything a martial artist could plausibly stop. Reaches only as far as you can reach. Recast each turn or pay 1 success per extra turn. No Quintessence unless done with chi. Dodging can pass as coincidental; stopping things in mid-air or deflecting energy is vulgar.

optional.purpose: chi-powered version, costs Quintessence

name: Velocity Boost for Throws and Shots
summary: Nudge gravity and momentum so a thrown knife, arrow or bullet flies faster and truer.
system: Arete difficulty 5. Each success lowers the throw or shot difficulty by -1, at most -3, and Forces adds one automatic success to damage.

name: The Chow Yun Fat
summary: Dive through the air with both guns blazing and still hit what you aim at.
system: Dexterity + Firearms at difficulty 8; each Arete success lowers it by -1 (max -3). Hit one target per success, each for the gun's base damage only. Pistols and small SMGs only.

name: Time Dilation in Combat: Bullet Time
summary: Stretch time around yourself in a fight to get extra actions, or slow a foe down. Without tying it to one person, the whole area runs in bullet time.
system: One extra action per two successes, or the same rate of actions taken from an opponent. Going past a 3x speed-up or slow-down turns it vulgar. More temporal tricks: Time Distortion and Travel, pp. 107-113.

combos.note: speed yourself, or the whole area

name: Battle Fury
summary: Work yourself into a killing frenzy: stronger, tougher, fearless and blind to pain, you attack every living thing in reach until the magick ends. No spells, no tactics, no telling friend from foe.
system: Life 3: 1 success per boosted dot up to 5, 2 per dot above, and soak lethal and aggravated. Mind 3: 3 more successes for the berserk state, no wound penalties, no fear. Plus 1 success per turn. Usually an extended ritual. Only death, incapacitation or a Mind 4-5 Effect ends it early.

optional.purpose: grow claws and fangs, +1 success
heal damage taken in the fight
sustain the rage; aggravated blows for 1 Quintessence each
harm spirits, +1 success
extra actions, 2 successes each
find weak spots
smash solid materials

coincidentalIf: you do not visibly swell up or show other monstrous signs

name: The Shiva/Kali Murder Machine
summary: The battle fury taken to its horrific end: you become a many-armed incarnation of war, over twelve feet tall and more than a ton in weight.
system: Needs at least 30 successes. Gives all the battle fury powers at Strength 8, Dexterity 5, Stamina 8. About as vulgar as magick gets.

source.section: Martial Arts: The Shiva/Kali Murder Machine

name: Attach a Travel Effect to Its Subject
summary: Fix a movement Effect onto the thing it moves, so it keeps carrying that object or being wherever it goes instead of shoving it once and stopping.
system: The extra Sphere depends on what you attach to: Matter 2 for an object, Life 3 for yourself or a simple organism, Life 4 for another complex creature, Spirit 4 for ephemera. Beings that live on several levels at once need every Sphere involved (Life and Spirit for shapeshifters, Life and Matter for vampires). The same add-ons work for Correspondence Effects; see Forging a Tether.

name: Forces Speed Push
summary: Give a runner, rider or vehicle a kinetic shove so it goes much faster than it normally could. Push too hard and the body or machine starts to break under the strain.
system: Every two successes double the speed: a 10 MPH runner goes 15 with one success, 20 with two, 30 with three, 40 with four. A creature moving under its own power at twice its top speed takes 1 lethal level per turn for each success past the second, unless its body was reinforced first. A vehicle can take one success past its Max Speed per point of Durability, then loses 1 Structure per turn. Time 3 speed does not cause this strain.

optional.purpose: toughen your own body against speed damage
toughen someone else's body against speed damage
reinforce an object or vehicle against speed stress

name: The Old Mind-Push
summary: Convince a guard, cop or official that you are not the one they want, or that you are exactly who belongs here. The more dedicated the official, the stronger the Mind magick you need.
system: Difficulty is the target's Willpower (minimum 4); against a mage it is Willpower +3, against Night-Folk +3 or even +5. Groups use the normal coincidental or vulgar difficulty. The target may resist with Willpower at difficulty 6; if they beat your successes they keep their own mind, otherwise the push holds for the Effect's Duration.

combos.note: plant thoughts that beat determined scrutiny

name: Jam an ID Card Scan
summary: Make an ID card simply fail to scan, then talk the guard into waving you through because the reader must be broken again. Gets you past the first ring of security, not into high-security areas.
system: Essentially coincidental. Mundane scanners take 3 or more successes, special or Technocratic ones 5 or more. A failed roll rejects the card and a botch trips an alarm.

optional.purpose: push the guard to let you pass anyway

name: Data Spoof of an ID Scanner
summary: Feed most ID-reading equipment exactly the information it wants to see. Only the Technocratic Data Sphere can do this; mystic Correspondence cannot.
system: Essentially coincidental. Mundane scanners take 3 or more successes, special or Technocratic ones 5 or more. On a failure the ID is refused; on a botch an alarm goes off. The same trick gives a false reading on body scanners.

name: Luck a Fake ID Through
summary: Bend probability so a card reads as valid even though the data on it is wrong. It can be prepared in advance as a standing credential.
